name: Traditional Party Mix
author: Elaine Heuring
instructions: Preheat oven to 250°. Heat butter in large shallow roasting pan (about 15x10x2 inches) in oven until melted. Remove. Stir in season salt and Wercestshire sauce. Add Chex and nuts. Mix until all pieces are coated. Heat in oven 1 hour. Stir every 15 minutes. Spread on absorbant paper to cool.

name: Puppy Chow
author: Linda Menz
instructions: Pour cereal into large Tupperware bowl. In small saucepan melt chocolate chips, peanut butter and butter. Pour over cereal and shake until coated. Open bowl and add powdered suger. Shake untill coated

name: Water Chestnut and Bacon Appetizer
author: Maris P.
instructions: Wrap a whole water chestnut in half a bacon strip. Secure it with a toothpick and dip soy sauce. Broil until bacon is cripsy

name: Miniature Pizza Snacks
author: Ramona Bess
instructions: Brown sausage and drain. Add cheese and remaining ingredients. Spread on party rye bread. Bake at 375 degrees for 5 minutes on middle rack. May be frozen

name: Sausage Balls
author: Maris Elizabeth
instructions: Blend, shape into small balls. Bake at 350 degrees for 25 minutes

name: Sausage Snacks Italiano
author: Rick Schlosser

ingredients.name: 8 oz. can Pillsbury quick crescent dinner rolls

instructions: Separate crescent dough into 4 rectangles; press perforations to seal. Combine cheese and oregano; sprinkle over dough. Cut each dough rectangle crosswise to form 2 squares. Place a sausage link on each square; roll up. Cut each roll into 3 or 4 pieces. Secure each with a toothpick. Place cut side down on an ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 375 degrees for 12 to 15 minutes until golden brown. Refrigerate any leftovers.

name: Appetizer Meatballs
author: Kristie Milam
instructions: In a bowl, mix all ingredients together; mix well. Shape into 1 inch balls. Place on a rack in a shallow roasting pan. Bake at 350 degrees for 10 to 15 minutes. Remove the meatballs and rack and drain. Sauce is next recipe

name: Appetizer Meatballs Sauce
author: Kristie Milam

ingredients.name: 14 oz. bottle of hot or regular ketchup

instructions: Combine ketchup and cornstarch in roasting pan. Stir in jellies; add meatballs. Cover and bake for 30 minutes.

name: Hush Puppies
author: Shirley Drury
instructions: Beat together the corn meal, baking powder, salt, milk and water. Blend in egg and onion. With hands, mold mixture into little cakes (about 1 tablespoon each) and fry in about 1 inch deep fat until well browned (1 1/2 minutes on each side). Drain on paper. Serve very hot.

name: Hush Puppies
author: Shirley Drury
instructions: Mix well, all ingredients. Drop onto cookie sheet using a tea- spoon and bake between 350° and 375° until done

name: Honey Mustard Crunch (Quaker Oatmeal Squares Low-Fat Snack Mix)
author: Karla Essner

ingredients.name: c. fat free mini pretzel sticks

instructions: Heat oven to 250°. Spray 13 x 9 inch baking pan with nonstick cooking spray. In pan, combine cereal and pretzels; set aside. Place margarine in 2-cup microwaveable bowl. Microwave at HIGH 45 sec- onds or until melted. Stir in mustard, honey and garlic salt; mix well. Pour margarine mixture evenly over cereal mixture. Stir evenly to coat. Bake 1 hour, stirring every 15 minutes. Spread on baking sheet to cool. Stir to break up crunch mix. Store in tightly covered contain- er up to 5 days. Makes 10 cups.

name: Caramel Corn
author: Donna Essner
instructions: Combine brown sugar, margarine, corn syrup and salt in sauce pan and bring to boil. Boil 5 minutes. Remove from heat, beat baking soda in vigorously. Stir in nuts. Stir in nuts. Place popcorn in a large shallow pan, pour caramel mixture over popcorn. Mix until popcorn is coated evenly with mixture. Bake at 200° for 1 hour. Stir every 15 minutes. When cool, break up into smaller pieces.

name: Caramel Corn
author: Anna Bollinger
instructions: Keep popped corn warm in a shallow pan in a 250° oven. Com- bine margarine, brown sugar, molasses and salt in a saucepan and cook to a firm ball stage, 5 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in bak- ing soda. Pour syrup over popped corn, stirring well. Return corn to oven for 45 minutes, stirring every 15 minutes. Cool and store in an air tight container.

name: No Fuss Caramel Popcorn
author: Annita Layton
instructions: Place popped corn and peanuts in brown bag. Set aside. Combine brown sugar, butter, corn syrup and salt in a 2 quart glass bowl. or casserole. Microwave on high three to four minutes, stirring after each minute, until mixture comes to a boil. Microwave two minutes more, stirring after each minute. Stir in baking soda and cream of tar- tar until foamy. Pour mixture over popped corn in bag. Close bag and shake well. Microwave on high for 1 1/2 minutes, shake bag well and microwave 2 1/2 minutes more. (I usually shake bag at one minute intervals.) Shake bag and pour popped corn into a large roasting pan. Cool and stir to separate.

name: Oven Baked Popcorn
author: Shirley Drury
instructions: Pour popped corn into a large roaster. Boil remaining ingredi- ents, except baking soda, together for five minutes. Remove from heat and add baking soda. Stir until this quits bubbling. Pour over corn, gradually stirring after each addition to coat the corn. Bake 1 hour at 225° stirring every 15 minutes. Store in tight containers. Will keep crisp for several week.

name: Diabetic Caramel Popcorn
author: Charlotte Hooper
instructions: Spread popcorn evenly in large, shallow baking pan. In small saucepan, melt margarine and blend in honey. Pour over popcorn, stirring to coat all pieces. Bake at 325° for 8 to 10 minutes, stirring often. Cool slightly in pan before removing. Store in airtight contain- er. Serving size: 1 cup. Per serving: calories: 108, carbohydrate: 16g, protein: 2g, fat: 4 g, sodium: 42 mg. Exchanges per serving: 1 starch, 1 fat.

name: Popcorn Balls
author: Cheryl Stone
instructions: Melt marshmallows and margarine over low heat, stirring constantly. Add vanilla. Pour mixture over popped corn and shape into balls. Place on waxed paper.

name: Fruit Dip
author: Marilyn Friend
instructions: Combine sugar and flour in saucepan. Add enough pineapple juice to make smooth paste. Slowly stir in rest of juice. Cook over medium heat until thick. Stir in remaining ingredients. Cook until thick. Cool. Fold in Cool Whip just before serving.

name: Caramel Dip
author: Charlotte Hooper
instructions: Boil the unopened can for 1 1/2 hours. This makes a great dip for apples.

name: Dip for Apples
author: Gale Ledure
instructions: Mix together and dip your apples in.

name: Fruit Dip
author: Christine Estes
instructions: Mix together until smooth. Great with strawberries and grapes.

name: Fruit Dip
author: Rebecca Hooper

ingredients.name: (8 oz.) pkg. fruit flavored cream cheese

instructions: Cream the cream cheese; add marshmallow cream. When well blended, add Cool Whip. Serve with chunks of cantaloupe, honeydew melon, pineapple, apple, banana, grapes, strawberries, etc.

name: Fruit Cheese Dip
author: Shari Landewe
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and serve with apple wedges, pear wedges, strawberries or other fruit dippers.

name: Ro-Tel Cheese Dip
author: Marilyn Friend
instructions: Combine cheese (cubed) and can of Ro-Tel tomatoes (cut up); heat until cheese is melted. Great with Doritos chips. You may also add browned ground beef to cheese dip.

name: Mexi Dip
author: Carol Peters
instructions: May use about 4 c. jalapeno peppers, if desired. Cook and stir ground beef in 10 inch skillet until brown; drain. Stir in mustard, chili powder, onion, peppers, beans, tomato sauce and seasoning mix. Heat to boiling, stirring constantly. Spread in ungreased 9 inch casserole dish.

name: Mexi Dip Sour Cream Topping
author: Carol Peters
instructions: Mix sour cream, 2 tablespoons of shredded cheese, and chili powder together. Spread sour cream topping over ground beef mixture. Sprinkle with cheese. Serve with corn chips if desired. Makes about 3 1/2 cups of dip. 30 calories per tablespoon.

name: Taco Dip
author: Donna Stamp
instructions:
On a 12 to 15 inch pizza pan or platter, layer the first four ingredients. Top with chunks of salsa or picante sauce. Arrange tortilla chips around outside of dip and serve.
This is a favorite snack for teenagers. It's quick to make but does not last long.

name: Taco Dip
author: Charlotte Hooper

ingredients.name: Sliced olives or anything you like on tacos

instructions: Mix taco seasoning, sour cream and cream cheese until well blended. Spread on cookie sheet. Add your favorite toppings. Serve with tortilla chips.

name: Taco Dip
author: Linda Menz
instructions: Brown ground beef, add taco seasoning and simmer as directions say. Add refried beans and 1/2 cup picante sauce. In a separate bowl, mix cream cheese and 1/4 cup picante sauce. Layer in a 9x13 pan ending with a layer of cheese on top. Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes. Use corn or tortilla chips to dip.

name: Chili Cheese Dip
author: Christine Estes

ingredients.name: can Hormel Chili with no beans
(8 oz.) pkg. shredded Monterey Jack and Colby cheese

instructions: Spread cream cheese over bottom of 8 x 13 glass pan. Spread chili over cream cheese. Add green chilies (optional). Top with cheese and sliced jalapeno peppers (optional). Bake at 325° until bubbly. Let sit for 5 minutes before serving.

name: Chili Cheese Dip
author: Diana Judd

ingredients.name: (8 to 10 oz.) can green chilies and tomatoes
lb. processed American Cheese, cut in small pieces

instructions:
Brown ground beef, add taco seasoning and simmer as directions say. Add refried beans and 1/2 cup picante sauce. In a separate bowl, mix cream cheese and 1/4 cup picante sauce. Layer in 9 x 13 pan ending with a layer of cheese on top. Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes. Use corn or tortilla chips to dip.
For thicker dip: Stir in a paste or 2 Tbsp. flour and 3 Tbsp. water.

name: Chili Dip
author: Annita Essner
instructions: Spread cream cheese in 8 x 8 square pan. Layer jalapeno peppers on top. Spread can of chili on next. Top with shredded cheese. Bake at 350° until it bubbles. Serve with corn chips.

name: Onion Dip
author: Paula Castleman
instructions: Mix all ingredients and refrigerate overnight or several hours before serving. More onion and green pepper can be used for a stronger flavor.

name: Broccili Cheese Dip
author: Michelle Stull
instructions: Cook broccili and drain well. add the remaing inredients and cook until cheese is melted.

name: Neiman Marcus Dip
author: S.M.P
instructions: Mix together.

name: Shrimp Dip
author: S.M.P
instructions: Set out cream cheese to soften. Grate onion fine. Mix other ingredients. Serve with crackers, corn chips or potato chips. If refrigerated before-hand, remove from refrigerator and set at room temperature before serving.

name: Dill Dip
author: C. Allen Collier
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Refrigerate for at least 8 hours before using. Serve with chips.

name: Mexican Eggs
author: Donna Stamp

ingredients.name: (12 piece) pkg. flour or corn tortillas

instructions: Grease 9 x 13 pan. Tear tortillas into bite size pieces and saute in butter until soft. Layer (lasagna style), tortillas, eggs, sauce, onions, sour cream, and cheese. Repeat layer. Can easily be made ahead. Bake at 350' for 20 minutes. Good cold or reheated. Freezes well also.

name: Deviled Eggs
author: Ramona Glastetter
instructions: Shell the eggs, cut each in half and remove the yolks. Mash the yolks with a fork. Add all other ingredients to mashed yolks and mix until smooth. Fill the whites with the mixture.

name: Pickle Eggs
author: Emma Nichols, Donna Menz

ingredients.name: onion, grated (Onion Flakes can be used)

instructions: Mix all together and heat in microwave, let cool and put in eggs. Refrigerate. Makes 12 to 18 eggs.

name: Onion Rings
author: Janet Welter

ingredients.name: Vegetable oil or shortening for frying

instructions:
Peel onion; cut into 1/2 inch slices. Separate into ring. Place in a large bowl and cover with water. Refrigerate for 30 minutes, drain on paper towels.
Combine flour and salt. Add egg, milk, and 1 tablespoon of oil, beating until smooth. Dip rings into this batter and fry in hot oil or shortening (375) until golden on both sides. Drain on paper towels.

name: Braunschweiger Ball
author: Ann Glueck
instructions: Mix thoroughly. Form into ball.

name: Cheese Sticks
author: Caleb Estes
instructions: Sift flour, baking powder and salt into medium bowl. Cut in but- ter or margarine with pastry blender until mixture is crumbly. Add cheese. Toss until well blended. Sprinkle water over mixture and mix lightly with fork until pastry holds together and leaves the side of the bowl clean. Roll on a floured surface into a 12 x 10-inch rectangle. Cut in half lengthwise; then cut each half crosswise into 1/2-inch strips. Lift strips one at a time, twist and place 1 inch apart on ungreased cookie sheet. Bake at 425° for 10 minutes or until lightly golden. Cool before serving.

name: Denise's Cheese Roll
author: Ramona Glastetter
instructions: Let cheeses soften. Mix all ingredients except paprika. Shape into roll. Sprinkle with paprika.

name: Our Favorite Cheese Roll
author: Sara Hooper
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Shape into ball or roll.

yield.name: Mix all ingredients. Shape into ball or roll.

name: Party Cheese Roll
author: Germaine Robert

ingredients.name: (8 oz.) pkg. shredded sharp Cheddar cheese

instructions: Combine softened cream cheese, and Cheddar cheese, mixing until well blended. Add remaining ingredients. Mix well. Shape into ball, roll ball in crushed nuts. Chill before serving.

name: Cheese Ball
author: Helen Menz, Donna Menz
instructions: Take first 4 ingredients from refrigerator and soften at room temperature until they are soft enough to blend with mixer at stir speed. Add remaining ingredients until well mixed. Make a ball and sprinkle with paprika and chili powder or roll in chopped nuts.

name: Cheese Ball
author: Shirley Drury

ingredients.name: (8 oz.) pkg. Kraft shredded sharp Cheddar cheese

instructions: Combine cream cheese and Cheddar cheese. Mix well. Add all other ingredients except pecans and mix until well blended. Put the chopped nuts on wax paper, shape cheese mixture into a ball and roll in the nuts. Let chill for a few hours in refrigerator before serving.

name: Cheese Ball
author: Annita Layton
instructions: Blend both cheeses till smooth. Add remaining ingredients. Mix well. Shape into ball and sprinkle with paprika or chopped pecans.

name: Oyster Crackers
author: Donna Stamp
instructions: Mix oil, dillweed, lemon pepper, garlic salt, and ranch dressing. Pour over crackers. Bake at 250° for 15 to 20 minutes stirring halfway through cooking time. Cool on wax paper. Great snack. Freezes well.

name: Tuna Cheese Spread
author: Donna Menz

ingredients.name: (6 oz.) pkg. cream cheese (8 oz. can be used)

instructions: Let cream cheese soften to room temperature. Add drained tuna and mayonnaise. Add lemon juice, curry powder and salt. Mix to blend well. Add onions and stir. Chill for 1 hour.

name: Peppered Pecans
author: Rebecca Hooper
instructions:
Preheat the oven to 250°. In a small skillet, melt the butter over medium heat. Add the garlic, Tabasco sauce, and salt, and cook for a minute. Toss the pecans with the butter mixture and spread the nuts in a single layer on a baking sheet. Stirring occasionally, bake for 1 hour, or until the pecans are crisp. Makes 3 cups.
This recipe was found in The Tabasco Cookbook. They make a great gift.
Tip: When making popcorn, shake some Tabasco sauce into the cooking oil before adding the kernels for popcorn with a zing.

name: Spiced Nuts
author: Lorena Essner
instructions: Mix egg whites and nuts. Mix sugar and spices. Pour over nut mixture. Bake at 300° for 25 minutes, stirring in between.

name: Pineapple Dessert
author: Lorenna Essner
instructions: Drain juice from pineapple. Add eggs, flour, and sugar. Cook until thick. Add pineappleand marshmallows.

name: Bread and Butter Pickles
author: Hazel Luebbers
instructions: Cover cucumbers, onions and salt with cold water and ice cubes. Let sit about 3 hours. Do not use metal container. Mix sugar, vinegar, turmeric, cloves and celery seed and simmer 30 minutes. Pour cold water off cucumbers and pack in jars; cover with hot liquid. Process 10 minutes in hot water bath.

name: Creamy Peach Dessert
author: Lorena Essner

ingredients.name: water or 3 c. water and 1/2 c. peach juice

instructions: Mix together graham cracker crumbs, sugar and margarine. Make crust of 1/2 mixture in 9 x 13 inch pan. Do not bake or chill. Combine pudding, Jell-O and water in sauce pan. Cook and stir over medi- um heat until mixture comes to a full boil. Pour into bowl and chill until it begins to jell. Add peaches and fold in whipped topping. Then spoon into crust and sprinkle with remaining crumbs. Chill.

name: Dill Pickles (Addition To Each Quart Jar)
author: Hazel Leubbers
instructions: Add all ingredients to jars. Pour the hot liquid over the cucum- bers and then seal. Let the jars set for 3 weeks before using. Makes 4 quarts

name: Dill Pickles (Hot liquid)
author: Hazel Leubbers
instructions: Mix all ingredients and bring to a boil.

name: Sweet and Sour Dill Pickles
author: Ryan Brock

ingredients.name: medium size cucumbers (to fill 4 qt. size jars)
c. salt (use good canning salt for best results)

instructions: Wash cucumbers and cut into chunks, enough to fill 4 quarts. To each jar add 3 or 4 slices of onion, 2 pieces of celery and 2 heads of dill. Dissolve sugar and salt in vinegar and water; bring to a boil. Place cucumbers in jars, then cover with hot sugar, salt, vinegar and water. Seal at once. For best results, do not use for 30 days. Makes 4 quarts.

name: Sweet Pickles
author: In Memory of Ella I. Schlosser

ingredients.name: lb. cucumbers, peeled, seeded and cut into sticks

instructions: First day: place lime in 2 gallons of water with cucumber sticks. Soak for 24 hours. Second day: remove from lime water and wash through four waters. Then fix 1/4 pound of alum in 2 gallons of water and soak sticks for 12 hours. Third day: remove from alum water. Wash one time, soak in clear water for 6 hours. Drain. Make a syrup of vinegar, 1 quart water, sugar, and salt. Add spices. Boil and pour over cucumbers. Let stand 4 hours. Then place syrup over heat and boil until clear 30 - 35 minutes. Place sticks in jars and seal.

name: Cucumber relish
author: In Memory of Ella I. Schlosser

name: Traditional Hush Stew
author: Fr. Oliver Clavin
instructions:
Remove the fat from the meat and cut in 8 to 10 sections through the bone. Do not remove the bone, as this adds flaver. Peel the potatoes and slice one-third of them in thin slices. Leave the rest of the potatoes whole.
Into a saucepan, put the thinly sliced potatoes, then a layer of sliced onions, and then the sections of lamb. Season well. Add the thyme and another layer of sliced onion. Cover with the remainder of the potatoes, which have been left whole. Season again and add 2 cups of water. Cover the pot with foil and with a very tight-fitting lid. (See note.)
Cook in 350° oven for 2 1⁄2 hours or simmer gently on top of the stove for the same time. The thinly sliced potatoes at the bottom of the pot should dissolve and thicken the juice, while the potatoes on top retain their shape and remain floury. This stew is very easy on the digestion.
Note: In the old days in Ireland, the stew was first covered with a thick paste of flour and water to seal in the steam. Then the lid was placed on top. When the stew was cooked, the paste was thrown to the hens and the stew was eaten with great relish.

name: Kelso Ladies Chili
author: St. Augustine Cafeteria

ingredients.name: c. and 1 tsp. salt, or as desired

instructions: Put ground beef and spices in pot and brown well. Stir constantly or it will stick. When brown, add tomato juice and pinto beans. Bring to a boil. Then add sugar. Stir constantly or it will burn and stick very fast. Use French's brand spices. This makes a very large pot full.

name: Chicken Vegetable Noodle Soup
author: Lois and Lynna Drury

ingredients.name: bags of Kluski or homemade noodles

instructions: In a large stew pot, place hen, spices, tomato juice and puree. Add water to pot a little over half full. Cook chicken until done. Re- move and debone. Place celery pieces, carrots, onions and cabbage in bubbling broth. Cook until done. Remove vegetables to a warm plat- ter. Drop noodles in broth and cook until done. Serve noodle soup in soup bowls and add vegetables and chicken on top or serve them as a side dish.

name: Potato Soup
author: Rita Koeppel
instructions: Peel the potatoes and cut into small cubes. Boil until soft in large pot. While potatoes are boiling, brown beef. Put beef in pot with pota- toes. Add all of above seasonings to taste. Pour milk in to give white, creamy texture. Pour some instant potato flakes in to thicken slightly if desired.

name: Potato Soup
author: Kristie Milam
instructions: Cook onion in oleo. Add to potatoes, celery, carrots, chicken broth, salt and pepper. Cover and simmer on low to medium heat for 15 minutes. Add milk and heat until hot, but do not let boil. Blend flour and 1/2 cup of milk until thickened. Add to soup and heat until slightly thickened.

name: Snow Day Potato Soup
author: Francie Rosenquist

ingredients.name: lb. bacon, cooked crisp and crumbled

instructions: Chop potatoes (skin on) into 1-inch chunks and just barely cov- er with water, cook until almost tender. Saute onions and celery in stick of butter, add to potatoes and water. Mix flour and milk, add to potato mixture. Let simmer for 1/2 hour to thicken and add salt and pepper. Serve in bowls or crocks, topped with 1 tablespoon sour cream, grated cheese, green onion and crumbled bacon. Great served with warm, crusty bread and butter.

name: Paul's Beef Vegetable Soup
author: Paul Essner
instructions: Cook beef in pan of water about 2 hours. Then add all of the ingredients except the cabbage. Cook about 11/2 to 2 hours. Add the cut up head of cabbage 30 minutes before soup is finished cooking. Season to taste.

name: French Onion Soup
author: Shirley Drury
instructions:
Slice onions 1/8-inch thick. Melt butter, place onions in it, saute slowly for 1 1/2 hours in a large soup pot. Add all other ingredients except bouillon, saute over low heat 10 minutes more. Add bouillon and simmer for 2 hours. Adjust color to a rich brown with caramel coloring or kitchen bouquet. Season with salt to taste. Put in refrigerator overnight. This recipe yields 2 quarts of finished soup.
Proper serving: Heat soup. Fill fireproof casserole or individual fireproof bowls with 8 ounces of soups, top with three 1/2-inch slice of French bread and top with 1 1/2 ounces imported Swiss cheese, place under broiler until brown, approximately 5 minutes at 550 degrees.

name: Cheese Soup
author: Rebecca Hooper
instructions: Mix bouillon cubes, water, onion, celery and potatoes together. Cover and cook 20 to 30 minutes. Add remaining vegetables and cook until tender. Add cream of chicken soup and 1 cup water. Add Velveeta cheese and cook slowly until all cheese is melted. Sprinkle in bacon crumbs.

name: Creamy Swiss and Broccoli Soup
author: Zachary Estes
instructions: Boil ham in water for 10 minutes; add broccoli. Cook until ten- der. Gradually add milk to flour, stirring until well blended. Gradually add milk mixture to ham mixture, stirring constantly until mixture slightly thickens. Simmer 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add cheese and seasonings. Cook until cheese begins to melt.

name: Kelso Ladies Slaw Mixture
author: Kelso Ladies
instructions: Mix vinegar, sugar, oil, salt and pepper together and let stand. To slaw, add onions, carrots and 2 dippers full of dressing mixture.

name: Slaw
author: Shirley Drury
instructions: Mix together and pour over shredded cabbage, carrots, onions and celery. Serve immediately or refrigerate.

name: Cabbage Slaw Salad
author: Louise Alderman
instructions: Crumble Ramen noodles in large bowl. Add cabbage, red cab- bage, broccoli, seeds and green onions. Mix well. To make dressing combine oil, broth, sugar and vinegar in a shaker bottle. Shake to dissolve broth. Pour over vegetable mixture. If dry, may need more dressing

name: Cucumbers In Sour Cream
author: Shirley Eftink
instructions: Mix all ingredients except cucumbers. Chill. If more spicy taste is desired, add more vinegar, mustard, etc. Wash 2 cucumbers; cut off ends to seeds and slice in about 1/4-inch slices; pour sour cream dressing over cucumbers. Let marinate. Keep chilled and turn a couple of times. Makes a little over 1 cup. Serve on coleslaw or vegetable salad.

name: Chicken Salad
author: Shirley Drury
instructions: Combine chicken, celery, salt, eggs, and pickles. Moisten with mayonnaise: serve on lettuce and garnish with additional egg slices and olives.

name: Fruited Chicken Salad
author: Annita Layton
instructions: Combine first four ingredients, mix well. Add remaining ingredients and refrigerate.

name: Hot Chicken Salad
author: Maris Elizabeth
instructions: This ingredient is for topping. Can also use potato chips. Mix all ingredients and bake at 350° for 25 minutes. Do not overbake.

name: Spaghetti Salad
author: Donna Stamp
instructions: Break spaghetti into small pieces and boil until soft. Mix tomato, green pepper and croutons in bowl. Add cooked spaghetti and mix in dressing. May be eaten hot or cold.

name: Pasta House Salad
author: Bonnie LeGrand

ingredients.name: head red leaf or romaine lettuce

instructions: Drain and cut the artichoke hearts but reserve the water. Mix the above ingredients (except the artichoke heart water) one hour before serving. Add dressing right before serving.

ingredients.name: pkg. Good Seasons Zesty Italian Mix
c. Regina red wine vinegar with garlic

name: Caesar Salad
author: Rebecca Hooper

ingredients.name: small heads romaine lettuce, thoroughly chilled

instructions:
To coddle egg, cook whole egg in hot but not boiling water for 2 minutes.
Wash romaine, remove outside leave. Break the tender leaves crosswise into pieces about 1 inch wide. Store in plastic bag in refriger- ator until ready to use. When ready to serve, place romaine in large wooden salad bowl. In a small mixing bowl, combine seasonings, lem- on juice, Worcestershire sauce, sugar, oil and vinegar. Mix thorough- ly. Break coddled egg over greens, then pour salad dressing over all and toss lightly. Sprinkle with cheese and croutons and toss again lightly. Serve immediately on chilled salad plates. Excellent with roast beef as well as steaks.

name: Seven Layer Salad
author: Irene Blattel
instructions: Cut up vegetables and arrange in layers. Add sugar to miracle whip and spread over top of layers. Sprinkle with cheese and Bac*Os. Make the day before serving to give a better flavor.

name: Overnight Layered Salad
author: Sharen
instructions:
Layer lettuce, cauliflower, broccoli and peas in that order. Mix sour cream, mayonnaise and sugar; spread on top. Sprinkle with grated cheese, crumbled bacon and sliced eggs. Cover and chill overnight.
Can add to other vegetables like, small onion (diced) and green peppers (diced).

name: Layered Salad
author: Donna Menz
instructions: Layer each item in a large container.

name: Layered Salad Dressing
author: Donna Menz
instructions: Mix together well and top salad. Then top with bacon bits or fried bacon, crumbled.

name: Spinach Salad
author: Anna Rose Bles

ingredients.name: slices bacon, fried and broken in pieces

instructions: Mix together oil, vinegar, catsup, sugar, onion, and seasoned salt. Refrigerate overnight. Mix together bacon, eggs, nuts and spinach. Stir in dressing.

name: Spinach Salad
author: Charlotte Hooper

ingredients.name: fresh slices of bacon crumbles, cooked

instructions:
Place spinach in bowl. Add salt, pepper, and vinegar. Heat vegetable oil until hot. Pour over spinach to wilt. Then add chopped eggs and crumbled bacon. Serve immediately.
This recipe can also be used for leaf lettuce. Just eliminate the eggs and bacon.

name: Frozen Fruit Salad
author: Hope Essner
instructions: Throw it together. Freeze in 9 or 12 inch round pan.

name: Fruit Salad
author: Shelley Dohogne

ingredients.name: Any fresh fruit (kiwi, bananas, strawberries, etc.)

instructions: Drain fruit juices in bowl and mix in instant pudding and Tang. Pour mixture over fruit. Chill 3 to 5 hours before serving.

name: Fruit Salad
author: Charlotte Hooper
instructions: Mix ingredients and chill before serving.

name: Coca-Cola Salad
author: Sara Hooper
instructions: Mix together cherry jello, lime jello and crushed pineapple. Put on stove and cook until boiling. Take off stove and add Coke and nuts to mixture. Stir in pan well; pour in bowl and refrigerate.

name: Sunny Fruit Fiesta
author: Rebecca Hooper

ingredients.name: c. black or red seedless grapes

instructions: Using a melon baller, scoop flesh from cantaloupe and honeydew into balls; set aside. In a large glass or ceramic bowl, combine sugar, lime juice, lemon juice, orange liqueur, and lime peel. Stir well to dissolve sugar. Add the cantaloupe and honeydew balls, strawberries, and grapes. Toss gently to combine. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 1 hour to blend flavors, stirring once or twice. Spoon the fruit mixture into serving bowls or hollowed-out melon halves, dividing evenly. Serve immediately.          Per serving: Calories 105 (3 % from fat) ,Carbohydrates 27g, Protein 1g, Sodium 19mg, Fat 1 g, Cholesterol 0 g.

name: Sunny Salad
author: Shirley Drury
instructions: Prepare gelatin as package directs. Chill until slightly thick. Fold in whipped cream, orange sections, and marshmallows. Pour in mold.

name: Hawaiian Salad
author: Jane (Schlosser) Ressel
instructions: Drain the fruit cocktail, pineapple, and mandarin oranges. Add other ingredients and mix well. Serve chilled.

name: Orange Salad
author: Cheryl Stone

ingredients.name: medium can of pineapple chunks, drained

instructions: Stir all ingredients together except JELL-O. Sprinkle JELL-O over fruit mixture and mix well. Refrigerate.

name: Pear Salad
author: Shirley Drury
instructions: Heat pear juice and pour over jello. Whip pears and cream cheese. Cool jello and add pears and cheese mixture. Whip cream and fold in nuts and marshmallows. Can also add maraschino cherries.

name: Layered Jello Salad
author: Shelley Dohogne
instructions: Dissolve Jell-O in water. Add strawberries. Stir until dissolved. Add pecans and bananas. Pour into 9 x 13 dish and chill. (Set extra aside.) Spoon on sour cream. Pour on remaining Jell-O. Chill.

name: Cranberry Salad
author: Shirley Drury

ingredients.name: c. pineapple juice (drained from crushed pineapple)

instructions: Mix hot water with gelatin and stir thoroughly. Add pineapple juice and cool. Pour sugar over ground cranberries. Let stand while gelatin is cooling. When gelatin starts to thicken, add cranberries, pineapple, celery and nuts. Place in mold and chill.

name: Cranberry Nut Jello Salad
author: Annita Layton
instructions: Boil for five minutes the cranberries, sugar and 1 1/2 cups of water. Set aside. Dissolve Jello in 2 cups boiling water, add and pineapple. Combine with cranberry mixture. Pour into mold and pecans chill. Can use drained pineapple juice in place of some of the water.

name: Cranberry Salad
author: Louise Alderman
instructions: Grind cranberries and marshmallows. Mix lemon Jello with 1 cup hot water, then cool. Add other ingredients and chill.

name: Watergate Salad
author: Irene Blattel
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Refrigerate.

name: Watergate Salad
author: Juanita Dannenmueller

ingredients.name: c. small marshmallows, more if desired

instructions: Mix all together. Don't drain pineapples. Don't make up pudding. Put in refrigerator.

name: Watergate Salad
author: Shirley Drury
instructions: Mix pineapple and juice with dry pudding until blended. Add marshmallows, Cool Whip and nuts. Mix together and chill. May be served as salad or dessert.

name: Cherry Dream Salad
author: Tina Blattel
instructions: Add all ingredients in large bowl and chill. Favorite for carry-in dinners.

name: Five Cup Salad
author: Rebecca Hooper
instructions: Mix all together and let set for 24 hours. Then serve.

name: Million Dollar Rice Salad
author: Catrina Stone
instructions: Combine cream cheese, sugar and mayonnaise until smooth. Add rice, cherries, pineapple and marshmallows and mix well. Fold in whipped cream and pecans.

name: Cottage Cheese Salad
author: Rebecca Hooper
instructions: Drain good, the pineapple and oranges. Mix JELL-O dry (do not add water) to the cottage cheese. Mix in Cool Whip and remaining ingredients. Best to chill over night.

name: Cottage Cheese Salad
author: Lisa Schlosser
instructions: Heat pineapple and JELL-O just long enough for JELL-O to dissolve. Let cool. Whip the Milnot and add cottage cheese, vanilla and sugar. Mix together. Chill. May add nuts.

name: Frog's Eye Salad
author: Donna Menz

ingredients.name: (1 lb.) pkg. Acini De Pepe, uncooked

instructions: Combine sugar, flour and salt. Stir in pineapple juice and eggs. Cook, stirring constantly until thickened. Add lemon juice; cool to room temperature. Prepare Acini De Pepe according to package directions; drain. Combine egg mixture and pasta, mix well and refrigerate overnight in airtight container. Add remaining ingredients and mix thoroughly. Refrigerate in airtight container until thoroughly chilled. Refrigerate leftovers.

name: Speedy Salad
author: Tina Schlosser

ingredients.name: can (1 lb. 14 oz.) fruit cocktail, drained
jar (4 oz.) maraschino cherries, drained and sliced

instructions: Prepare pudding as directed, fold in all ingredients and chill.

name: Strawberry Snowball Salad
author: Rebecca Hooper
instructions: Pour boiling water over gelatin in bowl, stirring until gelatin is dissolved. Stir in cranberry cocktail and cold water. Chill until slightly thickened but not set. Shape cream cheese into 18 balls; roll each in nuts. Sprinkle sugar over strawberries; mix gently. Pour 1/3 c. thickened gelatin into 6 cup ring mold. Arrange cheese balls evenly in gela- tin. Spoon in sweetened strawberries over the cheese balls and gelatin. Pour remaining thickened gelatin carefully over berries. Chill until firm. If desired, garnish with strawberries.

name: Thousand Island Dressing
author: Doris Moore
instructions: Stir together all ingredients. Cover; chill.

name: Dressing For Lettuce
author: Helen Menz, Donna Menz
instructions: Mix all together and pour over lettuce. Use for cucumbers too.

name: French Dressing
author: Annita Layton
instructions: Mix in blender. Chill well before serving.

name: Hot Potato Salad
author: Shirley Drury
instructions: Cook potatoes, drain, peel, slice. Fry bacon until crisp, drain. Combine onion, vinegar, water, sugar, salt, pepper and mustard. Heat well. Add to potatoes. Then add bacon and parsley, mixing carefully with fork so potatoes are not broken. Heat slowly.

name: Pizza Salad
author: Linda Menz
instructions: Unroll crescent rolls, lay flat on cookie sheet. bake 5-8 minutes until light brown. Cool. Mix all other ingredients and spread on top of cooled crust. Dice in very small pieces 1/4 cup to 1/2 cup of fresh vegetables. Can use carrots, broccoli, radishes. Sprinkle on top of cream cheese layer and top with shredded Cheddar cheese. Refrigerate.

name: Vegetable-Pasta Toss
author: Pat Schlosser

ingredients.name: large red onion, thinly sliced into rings
lb. bacon, crisp fried and crumbled
(8 oz.) can sliced water chestnuts, drained

instructions: Cook vermicelli using package directions. drain. Combine broccoli, cauliflower and onion in large bowl. Mix Parmesan cheese, sugar, salt, basil and mayonnaise in small bowl. Add to vegetables, toss lightly. Chill for several hours to overnight. Add bacon, vermicelli, croutons and water chestnuts just before serving, toss lightly.

name: Pasta Salad
author: Nicholas Dannenmueller

ingredients.name: bottle Hidden Valley Ranch Salad Dressing

instructions: Boil noodles in water and salt. Drain and cool under tap water. In large bowl, combine noodles, washed broccoli mixture and ranch dressing. Serve.

name: Oriental Marinade For Steaks
author: David Glastetter
instructions: In small saucepan, combine ingredients. Heat marinade over medium heat until sugar is dissolved and mixture is blended, stirring often. Remove from heat; cool slightly. Marinade steaks, turning occasionally, in refrigerator for at least 30 minutes. Cook steaks as desired.

name: Marinade for Beef
author: Joan Drury

ingredients.name: c. red wine or wine vinegar
London Broil or sirloin tip roast

instructions: For marinade combine first 9 ingredients. Pour over beef; cover and refrigerate for several hours or overnight. Cook beef on a grill, using the marinade as a basting sauce.

name: Spaghetti Sauce
author: Marian Essner
instructions: Cook together until tender. Put in blender or colander and put back on stove and heat to boil. Can while hot. Very Good.

name: Spaghetti Sauce or Pizza Sauce
author: Charlotte Hooper
instructions: Mix all ingredients leaving pepper and onion whole. Cook slowly until thick, about 2 hours. Fill prepared jars and seal. To insure good seal, pressure for 10 minutes on 5 pounds of pressure.

name: Barbecue Sauce
author: Joan Drury
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Heat to boiling. Let simmer 30 minutes. Makes enough sauce for basting 4 pounds of spareribs.

name: Kettle Beef
author: Leola Essner

ingredients.name: lb. roast, cut up in 2 inch cubes

instructions: Mix beef in bowl with flour, salt, pepper and onion until well coated. Put in a greased roasting pan with 1 cup of water. Bake at 400° for 30 minutes then turn oven down to 350° and bake for 3 hours. Check every hour to make sure it has enough water if needed. Add kitchen bouquet if needed when meat is done.

name: Beef Stroganoff
author: Rebecca Hooper

ingredients.name: lb. top round steak (1/2 inch thick)

instructions: Cut meat in strips 1 by 2 inches; dredge in 3 Tbsp. flour and brown in fat. Push meat to one side of pan, add onion; cook until soft. Add mushrooms, 1/2 cup consomme, lemon juice, salt and pepper to meat and onion mixture. Cover pan; cook over low heat 45 to 60 minutes or until meat is tender. Blend remaining 2 Tbsp. of flour with remaining consomme, add to hot mixture-cook over low heat until sauce is smooth and thickened, stirring constantly. blend in sour cream and heat; do not boil. Serve over hot noodles or rice.

name: Noodles Romanoff
author: Rebecca Hooper
instructions: Cook noodles as directed on package; drain. Combine noodles with remaining ingredients except grated cheese. Put in buttered 1 1/2 quart casserole; sprinkle top with grated Cheddar cheese. Bake in 350° oven for 30 minutes or until heated through and bubbly and cheese has melted.

name: Italian Round Steak
author: Sara Hooper
instructions: Cover bottom of cookie sheet with aluminum foil. Place steaks in pan. Cover steaks with dressing. Salt and pepper as desired. Add another layer of aluminum foil and combine edges. Bake at 350° until meat is tender. Approximately 2 hours.

name: Italian Beef in the Crock-Pot
author: Rebecca Hooper

ingredients.name: to 5 lb. roast, cut up in small squares

instructions: Place roast, bouillon cubes, garlic salt and Italian dressing in crock-pot. Add enough water to cover beef. Cook on low for 8 hours. Heat up garlic bread or spread garlic spread on French bread. Wrap in foil and heat in oven for about 10 minutes. Shred beef with fork and knife; serve with gravy on garlic bread. Add a salad and a vegetable to this 'delicious' sandwich.

name: Oriental Beef Strips
author: Rebecca Hooper
instructions: Brown slices of beef strips in cooking oil. Pour off drippings, measure and add water to make 1 cup. Combine with soy sauce, sugar, pepper and garlic; add to meat, cover and continue cooking 15 minutes. Combine cornstarch and water and use to thicken cooking liquid for gravy. Serve with cooked rice.

name: Beef Teriyaki
author: R. Parker
instructions: Wash meat. Place in shallow baking dish. Pour marinade over steaks, refrigerate 2 or 3 hours. Turn occasionally. Drain, reserve marinade. Place in shallow baking dish. Broil 12 inches from broiler for 15 minutes.

name: Pepper Steak
author: R. Parker

ingredients.name: green or red peppers, sliced into thin strips

instructions: Sprinkle beef with paprika and garlic and let set for about 15 minutes. Brown beef in butter. Add beef broth and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes. Add sliced onion and peppers. Cook for 5 minutes. Combine water, soy sauce, and cornstarch. Stir and thicken beef mixture. Add tomatoes, wedged. Leave only long enough to heat through. Serve over hot cooked rice.

name: Chow Mein
author: Sara Hooper
instructions: Brown and salt hamburger. Add remaining ingredients except noodles. Mix and bake 1 hour at 350°. Sprinkle Chinese noodles over top and bake an additional 15 minutes.

name: Minute Steaks
author: C. Allen Collier
instructions: Brown cube steaks and remove from skillet. Saute onions and peppers. Place mushrooms and wine in skillet over onions and pep- pers and add steaks. Heat until mushrooms and steaks are warm.

name: Swiss Steak
author: Shirley Drury

ingredients.name: lb. round or chuck steak, 1 inch thick

instructions: Combine flour, salt, and pepper; pound into steak. Brown slowly on both sides in hot fat. Pour tomato sauce and pizza sauce over meat. Top with onion slices. Simmer uncovered 10 minutes. Cover and bake in moderate oven (350°) for 1 hour or a little longer, until the steak is fork-tender.

name: Salisbury Steak Dinner
author: Ruth Schlosser
instructions: In a bowl combine soup, mustard, Worcestershire sauce and horseradish. Blend well. Set aside. In another bowl lightly beat the egg. Add bread crumbs, onion, salt, pepper and 1/4 cup of the soup mix- ture. Add beef and mix well. Shape into six patties. In a large skillet brown the patties in oil. Drain, combine remaining soup mixture with water and pour over patties. Cover and cook over low heat for 10 to 15 minutes or until meat is done. Remove patties to a serving plate. Spoon sauce over meat. Sprinkle with parsley.

name: Steak With Brewed In Taste
author: Ruth Schlosser
instructions: Pound flour into steak, cut in pieces and brown in oil. Place in casserole. Using the pan that the meat was browned in, saute onion. Add tomatoes, seasoning, and beer. Bring mixture to a boil. Pour con- tents over meat and bake at 350° for 1 1/2 hours.

name: Beef and Mushrooms
author: Shelley Dohogne
instructions: Place all ingredients in crock pot. Cook on low for 8 to 10 hours. Good served with plain or buttered noodles.

name: Dutch-Style Beef and Cabbage
author: Brenda Schlosser Morrison

ingredients.name: to 1 1/2 lb. beef round steak, cut 3/4 inch thick

instructions: Trim excess fat from meat, cut into cubes. Combine flour, salt and pepper; coat meat with flour mixture. In skillet, quickly brown meat on all sides in hot oil. Drain off fat. Transfer meat to crockery cooker; add onions. In same skillet, combine water, vinegar and bouil- lon granules. Stir together scraping browned bits from skillet; pour over meat in cooker. Cover and cook on low-heat setting for 8 hours. About 15 minutes before serving, cut cabbage wedges into 4 or 5 serving wedges. Cook in 3 quart saucepan in a large amount of boiling salt- ed water until tender, 10 to 12 minutes. Drain well. Serve beef mix- ture over hot cooked cabbage wedges.

name: Meatloaf
author: Patty Cope
instructions: Mix all ingredients together with hands. May need to add more or less potatoes, add enough to form a loaf. Place in baking dish and make a loaf. Put in oven, pre-heated to 350°. Bake for 45 minutes. When almost done, spread ketchup on top and bake a little longer.

name: Meatloaf
author: Rita Koeppel
instructions: Mix all ingredients in large bowl. Place in round or rectangle pan and shape as a loaf. Poke holes about 3/4 to 1 inch deep with finger in several spots on top of loaf. Cut green pepper in 4 to 6 pieces and lay them around edge of loaf. Pour topping over meat loaf, filling the holes. Bake for 1 1/2 hours at 300°.

name: Meatloaf Topping
author: Rita Koeppel
instructions: Mix ingredients in a small bowl or cup.

name: Meatloaf
author: Favorite Recipe of the Dave Carmen family.

ingredients.name: slices of toasted bread soaked in milk

instructions: Mix and bake in buttered pan for two hours. Drain and top with tomato soup. Heat until soup is hot.

name: American Chop Suey
author: Anna Rose Bless
instructions: Brown meat. Add celery and onion and cook, covered, for 10 minutes. Combine all ingredients. Pour in greased pan. Cover and bake for about 1 hour at 350°.

name: Steamed Fish
author: Bruce Blankenship
instructions: Place butter and lemon juice in a 10 x 6 x 1 3/4 inch baking dish. Microwave on high for 15 to 30 seconds or until melted. Arrange fish pieces, thickest end toward outside, in baking dish. Sprinkle with lem- on pepper and seasoning salt. Cover with plastic wrap. Microwave on high for 4 1/2 to 6 minutes or until fish flakes easily with a fork. Halfway through cooking turn fish over and sprinkle with a little more lemon pepper and seasoning salt. Test For Doneness: Because overcooking tends to dry and tough- en fish, microwave for only the minimum cooking time, then check for doneness. Fish will turn from translucent to opaque and will flake eas- ily. The inner areas should still be slightly translucent. They will fin- ish cooking during a 5 minute standing time while the outer areas will remain tender.

name: Chunky Clams and Pasta
author: Karla Essner

ingredients.name: can (19 oz.) Campbell's Chunky New England Clam Chowder

instructions: In saucepan, combine soup, parsley, and garlic powder. Add cooked spaghetti. Over medium heat, heat through, stirring often. Makes about 3 1/2 cups.

name: Ramona's Salmon Loaf
author: R.G.
instructions: Heat oven to 350°. Grease loaf pan. Flake salmon and remove bone. Blend in egg, stir in remaining ingredients. Spoon lightly into pan and bake for 45 minutes. Garnish with lemon wedges.

name: Salmon Patties
author: Ramona Glastetter
instructions: Mix well, can of salmon, egg and crackers. Form into patties and bake in 375° oven or spray skillet well with Pam and fry slowly.

name: Goulash
author: Julie Kenkel

ingredients.name: of a medium green pepper, chopped

instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. In skillet, brown ground beef, green pepper and onion, stirring frequently. Drain excess liquid. Add remaining ingredients, except cheese; mix well. Put in a 22 quart casserole dish that has been coated with vegetable spray; cover and bake for 25 minutes. Remove from oven and top with Mozzarella cheese. Return to oven and bake, uncovered, for 15 to 20 more minutes, or until thoroughly heated and the cheese has melted.

name: Plenty for 20
author: Carla Graviett

ingredients.name: can tomatoes, drained and diced up

instructions: Brown ground beef, sausage, onions and celery; celery should be tender. Drain. Melt the Velveeta cheese and stir into meat mixture. Add the remaining ingredients and mix well. Bake in two 9 x 13 dishes for 30 minutes at 350°.

name: One Meal for 600 People
author: In Memory of Ella I. Schlosser, Charlotte Hooper

ingredients.name: Cinnamon or red hots, 1 bag only

instructions: Get something for cooks for lunch, ham and dessert. This list of ingredients was used by mother, Mrs. Ella I. Schlosser, for her children's wedding meals. There were no preparation details found. All I can say, is the meals were fantastic.

name: Quick Dinner in a Skillet
author: Alice Walter

ingredients.name: large can of pork and beans

instructions: Brown ground beef, onions and bell pepper. Pour off excess grease. Combine all other ingredients and cook over medium heat for 10 to 15 minutes. Serve with green salad and rolls. This is a quick meal for someone on the go.

name: South-of-the-Border Special
author: Mary Ann Lumsden

ingredients.name: (15 oz.) can red kidney beans, drained
of a 1 lb. pkg. of nacho flavored tortilla chips

instructions: Coarsely crush the chips. In skillet brown ground beef, onion and garlic. Drain fat. Stir in water, tomato sauce, chili powder and oregano. Pour half the mixture into a 13 x 9 x 2 inch baking dish. Top with half the beans and half the chips. Repeat layering. Cover and bake the dish in a 350° oven for 30 minutes, or until heated through. Top with remaining ingredients.

name: Sea Island Cheddar-Jack Quiche
author: S.M.P.
instructions: Roll pastry into 12 inch circle and place in a 10 inch quiche pan. Bake at 425° for 10 minutes or until crust is golden brown. Cool. Saute mushrooms and onions in margarine in medium skillet until tender, about 8 minutes. Sprinkle bread crumbs in bottom of crust. Sprinkle with cheese and mushrooms. Mix remaining ingredients until blended. Pour into crust and bake at 375° for 50 to 55 minutes, or until knife inserted between edge and middle comes clean.

name: Quick Cheeseburger Bake
author: Karla Essner

ingredients.name: (10 3/4 oz.) can condensed Cheddar cheese soup

instructions: Heat oven to 400°. Generously grease 13 x 9 x 2 inch baking dish. Brown beef and onion together in skillet; drain. Stir in soup, vegetables, and milk. Stir baking mix and water with fork in greased baking dish until moistened; spread evenly. Spread beef mixture over batter; sprinkle with cheese. Bake 30 minutes.

name: Cheeseburger Pie
author: S.M.
instructions: Brown beef and drain. Put back in skillet and add next six ingredients and cook until onions and peppers are soft. Put meat mixture in a lined pie pan. For the topping pat cheese in saucepan; mix egg, milk, and add along with the seasonings. Stir until the cheese melts. Pour over meat in pie pan. Bake 20 minutes at 425°. Before serving you can pour either chili sauce or taco sauce around the outer edge. Cut into wedges.

name: Nacho Casserole
author: Anna Rose Bles
instructions: Cook rice. Brown beef. Add seasoning to beef. Put rice in casserole. Top with meat. Mix soup, milk, and sauce. Pour over meat. Top with corn chips. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: Cheeseburger Casserole
author: Shawn Schlosser
instructions: Brown meat with salt and pepper. Drain well. Add tomato sauce and mix well. In casserole dish that has been sprayed, alternate meat and cheese slices until all gone. Then top with biscuits and bake at 400° for 20 to 25 minutes.

name: Mexican Dish Casserole
author: Donna Stamp

ingredients.name: large bag of corn chips or tortilla chips

instructions: Line a 9 x 13 inch pan with aluminum foil. Cover entire bottom of pan with corn chips. Set aside. Brown ground beef and spread over corn chips. In a separate bowl mix cream of chicken soup, cream of mushroom soup, enchilada sauce and green chilies. Spread this mix- ture over ground beef. Slice Velveeta cheese and completely cover top of casserole with it. Cover loosely with aluminum foil so cheese won't burn. Bake at 450° for 30 minutes. Use rest of corn chips or tortilla chips to eat with the casserole.

name: Easy Taco Casserole
author: Kristie Milam
instructions: In a saucepan, brown ground beef; drain. Add salsa, mayonnaise and chili powder; mix well. In an ungreased 2 quart baking dish, layer half of the meat mixture, chips and cheeses. Repeat layers. Bake uncovered, at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes or until heated through. Just before serving, top with tomato and lettuce.

name: Cheese Enchiladas Sauce
author: Rebecca Hooper
instructions: Fry tortillas in hot oil for 5 seconds on each side. Dip tortillas in enchilada sauce; spoon some of the Cheese Sauce inside each and roll up. Place seam side down in a baking dish. Combine remaining Cheese Sauce and enchilada sauce; pour over tortillas. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes. To make sauce, melt butter; blend in flour, salt and paprika. Add milk and stir until sauce thickens. Blend in cheese.

name: Enchilada Casserole
author: Diana Judd
instructions: Brown meat and add onion, pimento olives, garlic, vinegar, tomato sauce, chili powder, salt, pepper, and water. Mix well. Bring to a boil. Reduce heat and cook for 20 minutes. Stir in flour and cook over low heat until thick. Remove from heat. Put a layer of crackers, meat mixture, and cheese in a 2-quart dish. Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes.

name: Beef Macaroni Casserole
author: Helen Menz

ingredients.name: (4 oz.) can taco sauce or some taco seasoning

instructions: Cook macaroni in water with salt until tender. Fry onion and ground beef in small amount of cooking oil until partially cooked. Add chili powder and taco sauce; mix well. Add soup and tomato juice. Mix in macaroni; pour into casserole. Cover with cheese. Bake covered at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: Rice-Beef Dasserole
author: Helen Menz, Donna Menz

ingredients.name: (3 oz.) can chow mein noodles or use bread browned in a skillet

instructions: Brown beef in large skillet. Add vegetables and rice. Cook until rice is golden. Add soup, salt, pepper, and Tabasco sauce. Heat to boiling, stir well. Pour into 2 quart casserole dish and cover. Bake at 350° for 25 minutes. Sprinkle noodles or bread over casserole before serving.

name: Beef and Rice Casserole
author: Patty Cope

ingredients.name: lb. beef cut in 1 inch cubes

instructions: Place beef in skillet and brown. In casserole dish put beef broth, melted butter, rice, onions, mushrooms and browned beef. Stir and place covered dish in preheated oven at 350°. Bake for 1 hour.

name: Crusty Beef Casserole
author: Shirley Boham
instructions:
Cook ground beef and onion until meat is browned. Drain and stir in tomato sauce and chili powder. Spoon meat mixture into a greased 12 x 8 baking dish. Top with cheese and spoon beans over cheese. Prepare cornbread mix according to package directions; pour over the beans. Bake at 400° for 25 minutes or until cornbread is golden brown.
Can use other types of beans also, like chili, red kidney or even blackeyed peas.

name: Crunchy Beef-Noodle Bake
author: Donna Menz
instructions: Cook ground beef and onion in 10 inch skillet, stirring frequently until beef is brown; drain. Stir in remaining ingredients except cheese, noodles, and nuts. Pour into ungreased 2 quart casserole. Sprinkle with cheese. Cover and bake 50 minutes at 350°. Top with noodles and nuts. Bake uncovered for 10 minutes. To serve later: cover and refrigerate up to 24 hours. Bake uncovered in 350° for 50 minutes. Top with noodles and nuts. Bake uncovered 10 minutes.

name: Beef and Zucchini Casserole
author: Donna Scherer
instructions: Combine all above ingredients in a casserole dish. Microwave on high 27 minutes or bake in 350° oven for 1 hour.

name: Potato Sausage Casserole
author: Clara H. Essner

ingredients.name: c. sliced and peeled raw potatoes

instructions: Brown sausage, drain and set aside. Combine soup, milk, onion, salt and pepper. In a greased 2 quart casserole, layer half of the potatoes, half of the soup mixture and half of the sausage. Repeat, ending with sausage. Cover and bake at 350° for 1 hour or until potatoes are tender. Sprinkle with cheese. Return to oven uncovered for 2 or 3 minutes. Garnish with parsley if desired.

name: Wyndham's Casserole
author: Suzanne Eftink
instructions: Saute meat, onion, peppers and celery. Place soup and rice in casserole dish and add meat mixture. Then pour boiling water over the top. Stir and cover with lid or foil. Bake 30 minutes at 375°.

name: Manicotti
author: Sara Hooper
instructions: Drain manicotti and place on foil in single layer. Mix next six ingredients together. Stuff pasta. Melt butter; add tomato sauce and garlic powder. Pour some sauce on bottom of baking dish. Add manicotti in single layer. Spoon remaining sauce over top. Sprinkle 1 cup Mozzarella cheese over sauce. Cover. Bake at 350° for 45 min- utes. Uncover during the last 15 minutes.

name: Cavatini
author: Brian Hulshof

ingredients.name: oz. pkg. mixed pasta shapes, cooked and drained

instructions: Brown ground beef and drain. Combine ground beef, spaghetti sauce, green pepper, pepperoni, and mushrooms. Heat through. Com- bine this mixture with the cooked pasta. Pour half of this mixture with the cooked pasta. Pour half the mixture in a 9 x 9 inch baking pan. Layer half of the Mozzarella cheese on top. Pour in rest of the ground beef mixture and top with the remaining cheese. Bake at 350° for 20 to 25 minutes or until cheese is melted and bubbly.

name: Spaghetti Pie
author: Tina Schlosser
instructions: Cook spaghetti according to package directions. Drain. You should have about 3 cups. Stir butter, cheese, and beaten eggs into spaghetti. Mix well. Form a crust with this mixture. Spread cottage cheese over spaghetti. Cook ground beef, onions, and green peppers until vegetables are tender and meat is brown. Drain off excess fat. Stir in undrained tomatoes, tomato paste, sugar, oregano, and garlic salt. Heat through. Pour on top of cottage cheese. Bake uncovered at 350° for about 20 minutes. Sprinkle the Mozzarella cheese on top and bake for five more minutes.

name: Spaghetti Casserole
author: In Memory of Ella I. Schlosser
instructions: Brown meat in skillet, add other ingredients. Add tomato soup and tomatoes. Cook 2 to 4 hours. After cooked, add mushrooms, sliced stuffed olives, grated cheese, and cooked spaghetti. Add water if too thick.

name: Easy Oven Spaghetti
author: Donna Menz

ingredients.name: (7 oz.) pkg. thin spaghetti, broken in half

instructions: Heat oven to 375°. Cook ground beef and onions in a Dutch oven until beef is done. Stir in remaining ingredients, except the cheese. Add uncooked spaghetti. Cover and bake about 45 minutes, stirring occasionally, until spaghetti is tender. Sprinkle with cheese and bake uncovered about 5 minutes until cheese is melted. I add 2 cans of tomatoes.

name: Italian Spaghetti with Meat Sauce
author: Donna Menz

ingredients.name: (7 1/2 oz.) can pitted olive, drained and sliced
envelopes Italian-Style Spaghetti sauce mix with mushrooms

instructions: Cook and stir meat, onion, and pepper until meat is brown and onion is tender. Stir in remaining ingredients except spaghetti and cheese. Cover; simmer 1 1/2 hours, stirring occasionally. Cook spaghetti and drain well. Serve with sauce and top with cheese.

name: Oven Porcupine Meatballs
author: Suzanne Eftink
instructions: Heat oven to 350°. Mix meat, rice, 1/2 cup water, onion, salt, garlic powder and pepper. Shape mixture into balls with rounded tablespoon. Place meatballs in ungreased baking dish. Stir together remaining ingredients. Pour over meatballs. Cover with lid or foil and bake 45 minutes. Uncover and bake 15 minutes more.

name: Korean Meat Balls
author: Karen
instructions:
Combine ground beef with soy sauce, oil, sugar, scallions, garlic, and margarine. Mix well. Roll the meat mixture into balls 3/4 inch in diameter. Place water chestnut inside meatball. Coat with flour, then dip into beaten eggs. Fry in hot well-greased skillet, turn over and cook until done. Drain on absorbent paper, serve hot.
To prepare ahead, cook meat balls in the morning. Place in cov- ered dish and refrigerate. Reheat by spreading meat balls on baking sheet and place in preheated oven at 300° for 5 minutes.

name: Lasagna
author: Carol Peters

ingredients.name: (28 oz.) can whole tomatoes, quartered and drained or equal tomato juice/sauce
(6 oz.) cans tomato paste Mushrooms, if desired

instructions: Saute beef in oil until browned, stirring to crumble meat. Stir in garlic, parsley, 1 teaspoon salt, tomatoes and tomato paste. Simmer uncovered for 45 to 50 minutes or until thickened; set aside. Cook noodles according to package directions; drain. Combine cottage cheese, eggs, 1 teaspoon salt, pepper and Parmesan cheese; mix well. Layer 1/2 of noodles, cottage cheese mixture, Mozzarella and meat sauce in greased 13x9x2 inch baking dish. Repeat layers; bake at 375° for 30 minutes.

name: Lasagna
author: Denise Glastetter

ingredients.name: box lasagna noodles 32 oz. spaghetti sauce

instructions: Cook lasagna noodles and drain. Brown hamburger; drain. Combine with spaghetti sauce. Blend cottage cheese and egg until smooth. In casserole dish, make 2 layers of: 3 meat sauce, 1/2 noodles, 1/2 cottage cheese mixture and 1/2 Mozzarella cheese. Top with 13 meat sauce. Bake at 375° for 30 minutes or until boiling.

name: Lasagna
author: Charlotte Hooper
instructions: Brown ground beef and boil the noodles. Mix the spaghetti sauce with the browned beef. In a large casserole, put a layer of noodles fol- lowed by a layer of meat and then a layer of cheese. Repeat layers until out of ingredients. Bake at 350° for about one hour or until cheese is melted and brown on the edges. Before baking, this dish can also be frozen and baked later. Makes large casserole.

name: Lasagna
author: Beverly Essner

ingredients.name: pint tomato juice or 1 lb. can of tomatoes

instructions: Brown meat and drain fat. Add garlic, basil, 1 1/2 teaspoon salt, tomato juice and tomato paste. Prepare lasagna noodles and cook according to package directions. Drain and rinse. In a separate bowl mix together eggs, cottage cheese, Parmesan cheese, parsley, 1 tea- spoon salt, and pepper. Lay half noodles in 13 x 92 x 2 inch pan. Spread with half cottage cheese filling, half Mozzarella, and half meat mixture. Repeat. Bake at 375° for 30 minutes. Let stand 10-15 min- utes before cutting into squares. Can be made ahead and refrigerated. Bake for 45 minutes in that case.

name: One Step Lasagna
author: Bonnie LeGrand

ingredients.name: oz. Mozzarella cheese, thinly sliced or shredded
(15 oz.) container Ricotta cheese or cottage cheese

instructions: Combine browned beef with water and spaghetti sauce in a bowl. Cover bottom of 13 x 9 x 2 inch baking dish with 1 1/2 cups of sauce. Arrange layer of uncooked noodles, slightly overlapping, on top of sauce. Spread half of the Ricotta and half of the Mozzarella and 2 tea- spoons Parmesan over the noodles. Add another layer of sauce. Re- peat with another layer of noodles, the remaining Ricotta and Mozzarella and 2 teaspoons of Parmesan. Top with layer of noodles. Pour remaining sauce over; spreading evenly to cover edges of noodles. Sprinkle with 1?2 cup Parmesan. Cover tightly with foil. Set on cookie sheet and bake in preheated 350° oven for 1 hour. Let stand, covered 10 minutes.

name: No Boil Lasagna
author: Donna Stamp
instructions:
Preheat oven to 375°. In a saucepan brown ground beef, drain excess fat. Add 1 quart spaghetti sauce and 1 cup water, bring to a boil. In a large bowl, mix together with cottage cheese, beaten egg, Mozzarella cheese, 1/2 cup water, 4 cup Parmesan cheese and parsley flakes. Add salt and pepper if desired. To assemble, use uncooked lasagna strips but rinsed in hot water before layering in a 9 x 13 inch pan. Approximately 4 Lasagna strips will fit in pan for a single layer, 3 lengthwise and 1 crosswise.
Layer as follows: 1/3 cup hot sauce, lasagna strips, 1/2 cheese mix- ture, 1/3 cup hot sauce, lasagna strips, rest of cheese mixture, 1/3 c. hot sauce, lasagna strips and remaining sauce. Top with 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese. Bake at 375°, covered with aluminum foil, for 40 minutes. Remove foil and bake for 15 minutes more. Important, let stand for 5 to 10 minutes before cutting.

name: Mostaccioli
author: Marilyn Friend
instructions: Brown meat and onions. Mix together other ingredients, except noodles. Add browned meat, onions, and Chili-O mix. Cook until thick.

name: Baked Mostaccioli
author: Becky Schwartz
instructions: Cook mostaccioli in large amount of boiling salted water for about 14 minutes. Set aside. In large saucepan, cook ground beef and onion until meat is browned. Drain off fat. Stir in undrained toma- toes, tomato sauce, tomato paste, undrained mushrooms, water, salt, sugar and basil. Bring to a boil. Cover and simmer for 10 minutes. Stir in mostaccioli and Mozzarella cheese. Place mixture into 3 quart casserole or 13 x 9 x 2 inch baking dish. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese. Cover with foil Bake in 350° oven about 30 minutes. Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

name: Mostaccioli
author: Beverly Essner
instructions: Prepare mostaccioli noodles as directed on package. Brown meat and onions in large skillet. Mix together sauce, soup, water,  oregano, and garlic powder. Add browned meat, onion, and chili mix. Simmer until thick. Pour over prepared noodles. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese, if desired.

name: Fettuccine Alfredo
author: Rebecca Hooper

ingredients.name: c. light cream or whipping cream, at room temperature
Tbsp. margarine or butter, cut up and at room temperature

instructions: Cook pasta according to package. Immediately drain. Return pasta to hot kettle or Dutch oven. Add Parmesan cheese, light cream or whipped cream, and margarine or butter. Toss gently until pasta is well coated. Transfer to a warm serving dish. Sprinkle with pepper. Serve immediately.

name: Creamy Fettuccine Alfredo
author: Annita Layton

ingredients.name: (8 oz.) fettuccine noodles, cooked and drained

instructions: In large saucepan, stir together cream cheese, Parmesan cheese, butter, and milk over low heat until smooth. Add fettuccine noodles and toss lightly.

name: Easy Fettuccine
author: Karla Essner

ingredients.name: (8 oz.) Velveeta Italiana Process Cheese Spread, cubed
to 9 oz. fettuccine, cooked and drained

instructions: Melt together Italiana cheese spread, milk, and Parmesan cheese in microwave or over low heat on stovetop. Stir in garlic powder. Add fettuccine; mix lightly. Serve immediately.

name: Marzetti
author: Nancy Weissmueller
instructions: Brown together, ground beef, onion, green pepper and season- ings. Mix remaining ingredients, but only half the cheese, with ground beef mixture. Pour into casserole dish. Sprinkle half of the Cheddar cheese on top. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes in 350° oven.

name: Zesty Ziti
author: Donna Menz

ingredients.name: lb. Italian sausage, cut into 1/2 inch pieces
Hot cooked ziti or shell macaroni

instructions: In 2 quart saucepan, over medium heat, cook sausage, onion, and green pepper with garlic until sausage is done and vegetables are ten- der. Spoon off fat. Add spaghetti sauce. Heat thoroughly, stirring occasionally. Pour over ziti and mix.

name: Pizza Burgers
author: St. Augustine Cafeteria
instructions: Brown ground beef. Mix all ingredients, except the cheese, together with meat. Spread on buns, top with cheese. Makes enough for 40, 5-inch buns or 36, 4-inch buns.

name: Bagel Pizzas
author: Dustin P. Glastetter

ingredients.name: Pepperoni slices and other favorite toppings

instructions: Slice bagels in half and place on a cookie sheet. Spoon on sauce. Sprinkle with cheese, meat, or other toppings. Bake at 350° for 10 to 15 minutes or until cheese is melted.

name: Rice-a-Roni Pizza
author: Emma Nichols, Donna Menz
instructions: Prepare Rice-A-Roni according to directions. Spread on 12 inch pizza pan. Bake for 5 minutes at 450°. Top with remaining ingredients. Bake until cheese is melted.

name: Pizza Sauce
author: Helen Menz, Donna Menz

ingredients.name: 1 lb. ground beef, browned and drained

instructions: Mix all together and heat until cheese melts. Pour over crust and bake at 375° for 15 to 25 minutes.

name: Pizza Dough
author: Helen Menz, Donna Menz
instructions: Mix all ingredients together to make crust.

name: Homemade Pizza
author: Charlotte Hooper
instructions: Add yeast and sugar to warm water. Mix thoroughly. Add salt and oil and mix well. Then add flour and beat vigorously. Turn dough on floured board and knead for 30 seconds. Let stand for 20 minutes. Roll dough to fit pans. Pre-bake dough for 10 minutes or until top of crust is no longer sticky. Top crust with favorite meat or vegetable toppings. Finally, add cheese. At this point, you can cover and freeze. Bake at 425° for 15 to 25 minutes.

name: Chicken Pot Pie
author: Annita Layton
instructions:
In a 3 quart saucepan over high heat, heat carrots, celery, onions and reserved 1 cup broth to boiling. Reduce heat to low; cover and simmer 10 minutes or until vegetables are almost tender. Remove from heat. Remove vegetables to small bowl, leaving broth in saucepan.
In small bowl with fork, blend 1/3 cup flour with 3/4 cup half-and-half; gradually stir into broth in saucepan until smooth; stir in remaining half-and-half. Over low heat, cook, stirring constantly, until saucepan is thickened.
Stir in chicken, cooked vegetables and 1 3/4 teaspoons salt. Spoon chicken mixture into 13 x 9 inch baking dish. Preheat oven to 350°. Prepare pastry.
On lightly floured surface with lightly floured rolling pin, roll dough into 14 x 10 inch rectangle. With knife, cut out small circle in center of pastry. Place pastry loosely over filling. With kitchen shears, trim edge, leaving 1 inch overhang; fold overhang under; make a high stand-up edge.
In small bowl, mix well egg yolk with 1 teaspoon water. Brush pastry with egg-yolk mixture. Bake 1 hour or until crust is golden and mixture is hot.

name: Easy Chicken Pot Pie
author: Martha J. Hamm

ingredients.name: (10 3/4 oz.) can condensed cream of chicken soup

instructions: Heat oven to 400°. Mix vegetables, chicken and soup in ungreased 9 inch pie plate. Stir remaining ingredients with fork until blended. Pour into pie plate. Bake for 30 minutes or until golden brown.

name: Chicken Pot Pie
author: Brenda Schlosser Morrison

ingredients.name: c. cubed cooked chicken or turkey
(10 oz.) can refrigerator Hungry Jack flaky biscuits

instructions:
Can use broccoli, cauliflower, carrots and potatoes.
In 3 quart oblong baking dish, combine soup, milk, thyme and pepper. Stir in vegetables and chicken. Bake at 400° for 15 minutes or until mixture begins to bubble. Meanwhile, cut each biscuit into quarters. Remove dish from oven; stir. Arrange biscuit pieces over hot chicken mixture. Bake 15 minutes or until biscuits are golden brown.

name: Joannie Burgers
author: Joan Drury
instructions: Mix thoroughly. Form into patties and place on hot grill. Grill until done.

name: Barbecued Beans
author: Anna Rose Bles

ingredients.name: (1 lb. 12 oz.) can of pork 'n beans

instructions: Brown beef and onion. Pour off fat. Add remaining ingredients. Mix well. Pour into 1 1/2 quart casserole. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

name: Barbecued Frank Burgers--Juicy Burgers
author: Helen Menz, Donna Menz
instructions: Brown ground beef, drain. Stir in hot dogs, barbecue sauce, pick- les and onions. Cover and cook for 15 minutes.

name: Juicy Burgers
author: Joan Drury
instructions: Brown meat, milk, and bread crumbs until meat is done. Add barbecue sauce, Worcestershire sauce, vinegar and sugar. Simmer until done.

name: Farmhouse Barbecue Muffins
author: Donna Menz
instructions: Separate biscuits and press each into the bottom and up the sides of greased muffin cups; set aside. Brown the ground beef; drain. In a small bowl, mix ketchup, brown sugar, vinegar and chili powder; stir until smooth. Add to meat and mix well. Divide the meat mixture among the biscuit cups using about a 1/4 cup in each. Top with cheese. Bake at 375° for 18 to 20 minutes.

name: Barbecue Beef Loaves
author: Shirley Drury
instructions: Place all ingredients in medium size mixing bowl. Mix well. Form into individual loaves and place in 8 4 x 6 4 x 2 inch baking dish. Bake in oven at 350° for 20 minutes. While loaves are baking, prepare sauce according to directions. After 20 minutes, spoon over loaves and bake 30 minutes longer.

name: Barbecue Beef Sauce
author: Shirley Drury
instructions: Place all ingredients except catsup and lemon juice in a small bowl. Mix thoroughly. Stir in catsup and lemon juice. Spoon over loaves; as directed.

name: Barbecue Beef Pie
author: Christine Estes
instructions: Brown ground beef and drain. Combine beef, barbecue sauce and brown sugar. Press crescent rolls on sides and bottom of pie plate. Bake for 5 minutes at 400°. Spoon meat mixture on top of rolls. Add cheese on top of meat. Bake for 10 to 12 more minutes.

name: Homestyle Tuna Pot Pie
author: Anna Bollinger

ingredients.name: pkg. refrigerated all-ready pie crusts (2 crusts)
(12 oz.) can chunk light tuna, drained
(10 oz.) pkg. frozen peas and carrots
(10 oz.) can cream of potato or mushroom soup
tsp. poultry seasoning or dried thyme

instructions: Line 9 inch pie pan with 1 crust; set aside. Combine remaining ingredients. Add salt and pepper to taste. Pour filling in pie pan. Top with second crust. Seal and crimp edges. Slit top of crust to vent and bake at 375 degrees for 45 to 50 minutes or until golden brown.

name: Onion Baked Pork Chops
author: Karla Essner

ingredients.name: envelope Lipton dry onion soup mix

instructions: Combine dry soup mix with bread crumbs. Dip chops in egg, then bread crumb mixture, coating well. Place in lightly greased shal- low baking dish. In conventional oven, bake at 350 degrees turning once, for 1 hour or until tender. In microwave, microwave chops, uncovered at medium power for 40 minutes or until tender; rearranging once. Let stand covered for 10 minutes.

name: Apple-Glazed Pork Loin
author: Shirley Drury
instructions: Have the backbone loosened from the ribs for easy carving. Rub a mixture of flour, salt, dry mustard and pepper over the roast; place in open roasting pan with fat side up. Roast in slow oven, 325 degrees, until meat thermometer registers 185 degrees approximately 35 to 40 minutes per pound of meat. Remove backbone in kitchen when roast is done. About 1 hour before roast is done, spread with a mixture of the remaining ingredients. Return to oven until meat is done.

name: Sweet and Sour Pork
author: S.M.P

ingredients.name: (8 oz.) can pineapple chunks and juice

instructions: In large skillet, brown pork in oil. Remove. Mix cornstarch with Juice from pineapple; add to skillet. Add vinegar, brown sugar and soy sauce. Stir over low heat until clear and thick. Add pineapple and pork. Bring to a boil and simmer for 5 minutes. Add green pepper and cook 1 to 2 minutes more, just enough to heat through and heighten color. Serve over hot cooked rice.

name: Stir-Fried Bean and Noodles
author: Karla Essner

ingredients.name: lb. beef top round or boneless sirloin steak
(3 oz.) pkg. Oriental flavor instant Ramen noodles
lb. broccoli florets or 2 c. frozen
medium carrots, cut diagonally into thin slices

instructions:
Cut beef steak lengthwise in half; cut crosswise into 1/2 inch thick strips. In medium bowl, combine seasoning packets from noodles, 1/2 cup of the water and cornstarch. Add beef, tossing to coat.
In large nonstick skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of the oil over medium-high heat until hot. Add broccoli and carrots; stir-fry 1 minute. Break noodles into several pieces; add to skillet with remaining 1 1/2 cups water. Bring to a boil; reduce heat. Cover and simmer over low heat 3 to 5 minutes or until vegetables are tender and almost all liquid is absorbed, stirring occasionally to separate noodles. Transfer to warm platter.
In same skillet, heat remaining oil over medium-high heat until hot. Remove beef from marinade. Add beef (1/2 at a time) and stir-fry 1 to 2 minutes or until outside surface is no longer pink. Do not overcook. Spoon beef and pan juices over noodles. Sprinkle with orange peel, if desired. Serve immediately.
This recipe has a total preparation and cooking time of 30 minutes. Nutrition facts per serving using beef top round steak: 476 calories, 37 g. protein, 22 g. fat, 33 g. carbohydrates, 5.2 mg. iron, 1019 mg. sodium, 83 mg. cholesterol. Nutrition facts per serving using beef sir- loin steak.: 486 calories, 35 g. protein, 24 g. fat, 33 g. carbohydrates, 5.8 mg. iron, 1024 mg. sodium, 84 mg. cholesterol.

name: Chicken Stir-Fry
author: Rebecca Hooper

ingredients.name: lb. boneless, skinless chicken breasts, slightly frozen
Tbsp. sesame oil or vegetable oil
green pepper, cut into thin strips
red pepper, cut into thin strips

instructions: Combine garlic powder, onion powder, ginger, brown sugar, soy sauce, cornstarch, and water in a small bowl and set aside. Thinly slice chicken breasts. Preheat oil in a wok or large skillet over medium heat. Add green pepper, red pepper, and snow peas to wok or skillet. Cook until vegetables are crisp and tender, 3 minutes, stirring con- stantly. Push vegetables to the side of the wok or skillet. Add chicken and cook until chicken is lightly browned, 3 minutes, stirring constant- ly. Add water chestnuts and stir vegetables and chicken together. Stir in seasoning mixture. Bring to a boil and cook until mixture thickens slightly, 1 to 2 minutes, stirring constantly. Serve over hot rice.

name: Chicken and Snow Pea Stir-Fry
author: Revella Schlosser

ingredients.name: skinned and boned chicken breasts, halved and cut into 1/4 inch strips

instructions: Combine broth, soy sauce, and cornstarch in a small bowl, set aside. Pour oil around top of a preheated nonstick wok or large skillet, coating sides. Heat at medium-high heat for 1 minute. Add chicken, cook, stirring constantly, for 4 minutes or until chicken is almost done. Add celery, pea pods, mushrooms and onions. Cook, stirring constantly, 3 to 4 minutes or until vegetables are tender and chicken is done. Stir in toasted almonds. Stir in broth mixture, cook, stirring constantly, until thickens and boils. Boil for 1 minute, stirring constantly. Serve over rice.

name: Drop Dumplings
author: Dottie Essner

ingredients.name: tsp. Witt's King O'York Gourmet Salt

instructions:
Cut shortening into flour, baking powder and salt, until mixture resembles fine crumbs. Stir in milk. Drop dough by spoonfuls onto hot meat or vegetables in boiling stew. (Do not drop directly into liquid.) Cook uncovered 10 minutes. Cover and cook about 10 minutes longer. Makes 8 to 10 dumplings.
Cheese Dumplings: Add 1/4 cup shredded sharp cheese (about 1 ounce) to dry ingredients.
Herb Dumplings: Add 1/2 teaspoon herbs (such as sage leaves, celery seed, or dried thyme) to the dry ingredients.
Chive/Parsley Dumplings: Add 3 pounds snipped parsley or chives to the dry ingredients.

name: Chicken and Dumplings
author: Leola Essner
instructions: Cook old hen to make broth. Remove when done, let cool. Then pick chicken from bones. Beat eggs and broth in bowl and mix in flour until stiff enough to roll out and cut. Cut dumplings and drop in boil- ing broth. Add butter and bouillon after you put in dumplings. Cook until tender and add the chicken.

name: Zachary's Favorite Chicken And Dumplings
author: Charlotte Hooper

ingredients.name: Flour, enough to make stiff dough

instructions:
Cook stewing hen until done. Save broth. Chop the meat into small pieces. Add juice and water to large saucepan. Bring back to a boil. Then make dumplings and add them to broth mixture. To make dumplings, mix eggs, 1/2 cup broth and salt together. Add flour, beating well after each addition. When dough is stiff, roll out and slice, dropping in boiling broth. Cook for 5 minutes, stirring after each dumpling is added. Add meat and stir well. Put lid on pot and let stand for 10 minutes. Salt and pepper to taste.
Note: I use a Kitchen-Aid mixer with dough hooki to knead the dough until smooth

name: Cashew Chicken
author: Annita Layton

ingredients.name: whole chicken breasts skinned, boned, and cut into chunks
Tbsp. plus 1 tsp. rice wine or rice vinegar

instructions:
