name: Hostess Cupcakes
author: Sara Snider

ingredients.name: pkg (18.25oz) chocolate cake mix with puddig (cupcake)
oz. frozen whipped topping - thawed but stll cold (filling)

instructions:
To Make Cake:

Place a rack in center of over and pre-heat to 350 degrees. Line 24 cupcakes with paper and set aside. Place cake mix, sour cream, water, oil, eggs, & vanilla in large bowl. Beat on low speed for 1 minute. Scrape bowl, increase speed to medium and beat for 2 minutes. Scoop batter into cupcake liners 2/3rds of the way full. Please pan in oven and bake until tops spring back when lightly pressed with finger (16-20 minutes). Remove from oven and place on cooling rack for 5 minutes. Remove cupcakes from pan & put on cooling rack for another 15 minutes before filling.

To Make Filling:

Place whipped topping, sour cream, powdered sugar, & vanilla in mixing bowl. Beat on medium until smooth. Put bowl in refrigerator until cupcakes are completely cooled. — Once cupcakes are cooled, put filling into an icing bag with large hole tip. Poke hole in center of cupcake with tip and squeeze about 2 TBL of filling into cupcakes. Place cupcakes in refrigerator to chill while making frosting.

To Make Frosting:

Melt butter in medium sized pan on low heat for 2-3 minutes. Stir in cocoa and milk. Cook, stirring until thicken and just begins to boil. Remove from heat, stir in powdered sugar, adding more if needed, until frosting is thickened and smooth and is the consistency of a hot fudge sauce. Ladle frosting over cooled cake and spread. Icing will harden as it cools. Use white icing & small tip to make squiggly line in center of cupcake.

author: CraftCreateCook.com
instructions:
Prep Time: 5 min
Cook Time: 30 min

* Preheat the oven to 375 degrees and spray a 12 count mini muffin tin with non-stick cooking spray.

name: Braised Mushroom Chicken Thighs
author: Holly Nilsson - spendwithpennies.com

ingredients.name: lbs chicken thighs with bone and skin

instructions:
Instructions
1. Preheat oven to 425°F
2. Season chicken with salt & pepper. Set aside.
3. Heat butter and oil in a 10 inch skillet over high heat. Add chicken (skin side down) and brown without moving the chicken, about 4-5 minutes. Remove from pan and set aside.
4. Quickly toss the mushrooms with soy sauce. Cook mushrooms, garlic, thyme and rosemary until mushrooms are tender, about 5 minutes.
5. Add chicken broth and white wine. Simmer 2 minutes.
6. Place seasoned chicken, skin side up over the mushrooms.
7. Bake 35-40 minutes or until chicken reaches 165°F. Broil 1 minute if desired.
8. Spoon mushroom sauce over chicken. Garnish with parsley and serve.

Notes
Do not add soy sauce to mushrooms ahead of time, this will remove too much moisture from the mushrooms.

name: Bread Pudding with Southern Bourbon Sauce
author: Barbara Garett - foodnetwork.com

ingredients.name: cups stale French bread, cut in 3/4-inch cubes
tbsp butter, melted and slightly cooled
cup bourbon whiskey, to taste (Use Armaretto instead of Bourbon) (sauce)

instructions:
Prep: 25 min
Cook: 50 min

Directions

Preheat oven to 350 degrees F.

Place stale bread in a bowl with milk and squeeze the bread with your hand until well saturated with milk.

With an electric mixer on high speed in a separate bowl, beat eggs with sugar until thick and pale. Stir in the vanilla, cinnamon, nutmeg, butter and raisins to the egg mixture. Add the soaked bread crumbs to the egg mixture and stir well. Let stand for 10 minutes. It is important to allow enough time for the bread to absorb the egg mixture or the bread crumbs will fioat to the top during baking, leaving a layer of custard on the bottom of the dish.

Transfer the mixture to a greased baking dish. Bake until firm, or until a knife inserted in the middle comes out clean, about 45 to 50 minutes. Let it slightly cool in the dish.

Bourbon Sauce:
Meanwhile, near the end of the baking time, make the saucs. With an electric mixer, beat egg yolks until thick and pale. In a saucepan, meit the butter and sugar. Pour the butter and sugar mixture over the egg yolks, beating constantly with the mixer, until well thickened. Stir in bourbon by hand. Serve the pudding warm with vanilla ice cream if desired. Pass the hot bourbon sauce separately.

name: Honey Garlic Pork Tenderloin
author: Ashley Fehr - thereciperebel.com

ingredients.name: pork tenderloins (trimmed - 1-1.25 lbs each, about 2-2.5 lbs total)
cup low sodium chicken broth (or sub water)

instructions:
Instructions
1. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F and lightly grease a 9x13 inch baking dish.

2. Place tenderloins in baking dish, brush with oil and season all over with seasoning salt.
3. Whisk together honey, broth, soy sauce, garlic, vinegar, salt, com starch and red pepper flakes.
4. Pour sauce around pork tenderloin in pan -- avoid pouring on top of pork as it will prevent it from browning.
5. Bake, uncovered, for 15-20 minutes until a meat thermometer reads at least 140 degrees F.
Remove from the oven and cover to rest for 10 minutes.
6. Slice pork tenderloin and serve with sauce.

Notes
Tips:
* Size matters: this recipe will not work with a pork loin which is much larger and requires a longer cook time. In the time it takes the loin to cook, the sauce will burn. If your tenderloins are larger than 1.25 pounds each, you may want to add the sauce for the last 15-20 minutes of cook time.
* Check the temp. As always, the best way to tell that meat is done is to use a meat thermometer. Pork chops should be 140-145F!
* Don't over-cook. Since pork is a lean meat, it can dry out more easily than other types of meat. Be sure to take it out of the oven as soon as possible after it reaches 140-145°F
* Let it rest. Resting the meat for 10 minutes before slicing into it is the key to juicy pork.

Substitutions:
* Slow cooker: you can make this recipe in the slow cooker! Simply add the tenderloins and sauce and cook on low for 3 hours or until done.
* Pork loin: I don't recommend pork loin for this recipe because they are so much larger and require so much more bake time. If you want to serve the sauce with a pork loin you are cooking, simply simmer it on the stove top until thickened.

name: Sara's New York Cheesecake
author: Sara Snider
instructions:
**Note, ingredients need to be at room temperature for best results**

Directions:
Preheat oven 325 degrees. Grease a 9” spring-form pan (bottom & sides) with Pam spray. Boil water (for water bath).

1. In medium bowl, mix graham crackers, sugar, and melted butter. Press into the bottom of spring-form pan and bake for 5-10 minutes
2. In large mixing bowl, beat cream cheese with sugar until smooth. Use wooden spoon to mix in the eggs 1 at a time and % cup milk until just incorporated (Do not over mix). Mix in sour cream, vanilla, and flour until smooth. Pour filling onto prepared crust.
3. Wrap the bottom of the spring-form pan with 2 sheets of tin foil to prevent water from penetrating crust/cake. Place spring-form pan into a water bath of boiling water about 17” deep. (I use a roaster pan and sit the cheese cake in it with the hot water)
4. Bake at 325 degrees for 1-1/2 hours then turn the oven off (do not open oven). Let the cheesecake stand in the oven for 3 hours then remove and refrigerate overnight.
5. Cheesecake should have pulled away from the edges during baking. Remove spring-form sides. Run knife between crust and bottom of the pan and move cake to serving platter.

name: Warm Molten Lava Cake
author: Sara Snider

ingredients.name: tbsp unsalted butter, room temperature, plus more for muffin tins
cup granulated sugar, plus more for muffin tins
ounces bittersweet or semi-sweet chocolate, melted
Whipped Cream or vanilla lce cream

instructions:
Directions:

1)Preheat oven to 400 degrees. Generously butter 6 cups of a standard muffin tin (or 12 smaller cupcake pan - but again you'll have to reduce the timing). Dust with granulated sugar, and tap out excess. Set aside.

2)In the bowl of an electric mixer fitted with the paddle attachment, cream the butter and granulated sugar until fluffy. Add eggs one at a time, beating well after each addition. With the mixer on low speed, beat in flour and salt until just combined. Beat in chocolate until just combined. Divide batter evenly among prepared muffin cups.

3)Place muffin tin on a baking sheet; bake just until tops of the cakes no longer jiggle when the pan is lightly shaken, 8 to 10 minutes (less for mini ones around 5-6 minutes). Remove from oven; let stand 10 minutes.

4)To serve, turn out cakes, and place on serving plates, bottom sides up. Dust with confectioners’ sugar, and serve with whipped cream (Or vanilla ice cream), if desired (Trust me you will desire it once you break into the yummy warm luscious lava cake and the chocolaty goodness oozes out).

name: Molten Center Chocolate Cake
author: Sara Snider
instructions:
1) These cakes can be made the day before and stored in the refrigerator, ready to bake. Preheat oven to 406 degrees F.
2) Prepare baking dishes by liberally spreading + srature butler into four 4-ounce molds of round soufflé dishes, or spray 4-ounce molds with pan spray.
3) Melt together chocolate and butter in a medium saucepan until melted and smooth, stirring constantly
4) In a separate bowl, whisk together egg yolks, eggs, veniila, sugar, and salt. Whisk in melted chocolate mixture. Sprinkle sifted flour over the mixture and fold in. Pour batter into each of the prepared dishes
5) Bake 20 to 30 minutes (longe rfor refrigerated batter), checking halfway through the cooking time. The Cake batter shuld rise above the sides of the dished and the top edges should be dark brown in color. Remove from the oven while the centers are still soft and gooey.
6) Using a paring knife, run around the sides of the dish to loosen the cakes. Allow cakes to cool at room temperature for 5 minutes.
7) To plate: Place your dessert plate atop one of the cake dished. Using oven mitts or a dish towel, hold the plate and the dish together and invert
8) Serve immediately with fresh Pontchatoula Strawberries and freshly whipped and lightly sweetened whipped cream or créme fraiche

tsp. (OPTIONAL) instant coffee powder OR coffee liqueur (Kahlua) - prev ingredient

instructions:
Instructions

name: The BEST Pineapple Upside Down Cake
author: Hayley Parker - thedomesticrebel.com

ingredients.name: (5-7) pineapple rings drained and juice reserved (topping)
cup full-fat sour cream or Greek yogurt (cake)

instructions:
Prep Time: 10 mins
Cook Time: 45 mins

Instructions

* Preheat your oven to 350 degrees F. Lightly grease the bottom and sides of a 9 inch round cake pan with cooking spray. In a small bowl, combine the melted butter and brown sugar and pour the mixture into the bottom of the cake pan, spreading it out evenly. Arrange the pineapple rings around the pan and place maraschino cherries in between. Set aside briefly.
 * In the bowl of a stand mixer, cream together the oil and granulated sugar until moistened. Beat in the egg, salt, baking powder, and vanilla until combined. Beat in the sour cream. Gradually add some of the milk, alternating with the flour until a soft batter comes together. Gently beat in the pineapple juice last.
* Carefully pour the batter over the pineapples in the pan, careful not to disturb their placement. Bake for approx. 40-45 minutes or until the cake appears set, is light golden brown, and a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean or with moist, not wet, crumbs. Cool for 10-15 minutes, then very carefully invert the cake onto a platter or plate. Serve warm or room temperature.

name: Pineapple Upside Down Cheesecake
author: Dana - ThisSillyGirlsLife.com

ingredients.name: (8 oz) packages cream cheese room temp (cheesecake)
tbsp vanilla bean paste or extract (cheesecake)
slices canned or fresh pineapple rings (topping)
cup all purpose flour sifted (cake batter)
cup light brown sugar packed (cake batter)
tbsp vanilla bean paste or extract (cake batter)

instructions:
Instructions

Pineapple Cheesecake
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees. Grease a 9-inch springform pan. Cream the cream cheese with the sugar until smooth in a large bowl. Mix in the milk fully then add in one egg at a time and mix. Add in the remaining ingredients and mix until smooth with no lumps.
2. Pour into the pan and bake for 1 hour, the center will be slightly jiggly. Shut off oven and let cool down in the oven for 5 hours. Top with plastic wrap and place in fridge overnight to get cold.

Pineapple Upside-Down Cake
1. Start with the topping by dividing the melted butter equally between two 9 inch cake pans. Sprinkle 1/2 Cup of the brown sugar into each pan. Arrange the pineapple slices and cherries as pictured, set aside.
2. Preparing and cooking the cake: Preheat oven to 350 degrees. In a large bowl, add in the sifted flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt, whisk to combine.
3. In a medium-sized bowl, add in the 1 Cup melted butter, brown sugar, and granulated sugar. Whisk to combine, getting all the brown sugar lumps broken up. Whisk in the eggs, sour cream, milk, pineapple juice and vanilla until combined.
4. Add the wet mixture to the dry mixtures and mix until combined, with no dry spots or lumps.
5. Evenly divide the batter between the two pans, about 2/3 of the way full, do not overfill!
6. Line oven with foil or two cookie sheets, cakes may bubble over some. Bake for 48-53 minutes, covering loosely with foil at the 20-minute mark to avoid burning. Cakes are down when a toothpick inserted in the middle comes out clean.
7. Place cakes on a wired rack to cool for 10 minutes.

Pineapple Upside-Down Cheesecake Assembly
1. Invert cakes, one onto a flat surface like a cutting board and the other on the plate you will be presenting on.
2. Take out the pineapple cheesecake. Trim top of the cheesecake if it is not even. Take it out of the pan and lift it off the bottom carefully, you may need to use a tool like a frosting spatula to help. Place on top of the first cake layer. Trim the sides of the cheesecake with a knife if necessary. Place the second layer of cake on top. Serve as is or with whipped cream, enjoy!

name: Hard Boiled Eggs
author: Lynn Terri (Rebecca Hooper)
instructions:
1. Get pot of water boiling
2. Carefully (so they don't break) add eggs to boiling water
3. Boil for 9 min
4. Get a glass bowl (large enough to fit all the eggs) and put in sink
5. Start running cold water in the bowl. While water is running, carefully put each egg individually in glass bowl
6. Let cold water cool them off for about 3 minutes. Then put generous amounts of ice cubes in the bowl (you want the ice to melt but not too fast. If it melts too fast, the water isn't cold enough so add more ice.)
7. Let them sit in the ice batch until they are cold
8. Pull them out of the water and peel. Perfectly peeled eggs every single time when done right

instructions: Heat oven to 350°. Mix thoroughly shortening, butter, sugars, eggs and vanilla. Blend in salt, baking soda and 3 cups flour. name: Baked Spaghetti
author: AllRecipes.com (Will Curnell)
instructions:
Step 1
Gather all ingredients. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Lightly grease a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Step2
Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook spaghetti in boiling water, stirring occasionally, until tender but firm to the bite, about 12 minutes. Drain.
Step3
Meanwhile, heat a large skillet over medium heat. Cook and stir beef and onion in the hot skillet until meat is browned and onion is soft and translucent, about 5 to 7 minutes.
Step 4
Drain excess oil from the pan; stir in spaghetti sauce and seasoned salt.
Step 5
Whisk eggs, Parmesan, and butter in a large bowl. Add spaghetti and toss to coat.
Step 6
Place 1/2 of the spaghetti mixture in the prepared baking dish. Top with 1/2 of the cottage cheese, 2 cups mozzarella, and 1/2 of the meat sauce. Repeat layers. Cover with aluminum foil.
Step7
Bake in the preheated oven for 40 minutes. Remove the foil and sprinkle with remaining 1 cup mozzarella.
Step 8
Continue to bake until cheese is melted and lightly browned, 20 to 25 minutes.
Step 9
Serve and enjoy!

Drain 1 lb. 4 1/2 oz. can of pineapple chunks.
Add water to syrup to make one cup, bring to boil and stir into 1 pkg. of lemon gelatin.
Blend half of hot gelatin into 8 oz. pkg. cream cheese, pour into chilled crust, chill.
Add pineapple chunks and spoon remainder of gelatin on top, chill until served.

name: Pumpkin Bread
author: Anne Brock
instructions:
Cream shortening, sugar and add eggs, pumpkin and water and mix well. Sift dry ingredients into pumpkin mixture, stir in nuts and raisins.

Turn into 2 greased and floured loaf pans
350 for 1 hr.

name: Chess Pie
author: Anne Brock
instructions:
Pour in unbaked pie shell.
400° for 10 min
reduce to 350° for 30 min

name: Fresh Strawberry Pie
author: Anne Brock
instructions:
3 pints strawberries, mash half and reserve remaining.
Add 1 c. sugar and 3 Tbsp. corn starch.
Cook 5 min until thickened and clear, add 2 Tbsp. lemon juice.
Add whole berries, saving some to garnish, and pour into baked pie shell.
Chill.
Top with whipped cream and whole berries.

name: Pumpkin Pie
author: Anne Brock
instructions: Bake 400 degrees for 50 minutes.

name: Strawberry Cake
author: Anne Brock
instructions:
Bake in tube pan at 350 for 30-40 min.

ICING

name: Apple and Cheese Salad
author: Anne Brock
instructions:
Serve with red wine dressing.

Red Wine Dressing: Mix well, refrigerate for 1 hr. Remove garlic.

name: Three Bean Salad
author: Anne Brock

ingredients.name: oz. can cut wax beans, drained
oz. can French style green beans, drained
oz. can red kidney beans, drained

instructions:
In medium bowl, toss together wax beans, green beans, kidney beans, onion and Wish-Bone Italian Dressing. Cover and refrigerate; marinate several hours, tossing occasionally.
Makes 10 servings.

name: Bean Salad
author: Anne Brock
instructions:
Drain beans well. Combine oil, vinegar, sugar, salt and pepper in the blender. Pour over beans and chill overnight. Just before serving add the chopped pepper and onion.
Serves 8.

name: Layered Salad
author: Anne Brock
instructions:
Prepare in order, spread dressing over top and let set overnight.

Add 4 hard cooked eggs after the diced celery.

name: Cranberry Salad
author: Anne Brock
instructions:
Cook until berries pop open. Set off heat and add sugar, jello, pineapple, pecans. Pour into 9 x 13 inch pan and refrigerate until firm.

Salad topping: (no combining directions given on card for the topping ingredients above)

name: Macaroni Salad
author: Anne Brock
instructions: 2 cups elbow macaroni, 1 Tbsp salt cooked in 3 qts boiling water. Drain. Combine with 1/2 cup each of: celery, green pepper and shredded cheese. 1/4 c onion, 1/2 tsp salt, 1 Tbs lemon juice, 1/4 tsp each of pepper and dry mustard. 2/3 c mayonnaise. Chill, serve on lettuce leaves.

name: Frozen Cole Slaw
author: Anne Brock
instructions:
Bring syrup to boil - boil 1 minute -
Let cool to lukewarm - pour over cabbage mixture - mix well. Pack in freezer bags. When ready to use - drain + add your favorite dressing.

name: Vegetable Salad
author: Anne Brock

ingredients.name: tsp. salt, and pepper to taste

instructions:
Drain all liquid from above items and mix together.
Add: 1 green pepper - diced small, 1 cup celery, diced small, 1 onion, chopped small, 1 teaspoon salt and then pepper to taste.

Mix 1 cup sugar, 1/2 cup oil, 3/4 cup vinegar. Add together in sauce pan and bring to a boil and boil 5 minutes.

Let cool and then pour over the above mixed vegetables. Chill at least 2 hours before serving.

name: Vegetable Salad
author: Anne Brock
instructions: Mix together and chill overnight.

name: Watergate Salad
author: Myrtle Young - Anne Brock

ingredients.name: oz. can crushed pineapple, juice and all

instructions: Mix crushed pineapple with dry pudding mix. Add nuts, cherries and marshmallows. Fold in Cool Whip. Mix well and chill. You may use a 9 inch pie dish with a graham cracker crust and you'll have Watergate Pie.

name: Jello Mold
author: Anne Brock

ingredients.name: c. hot water, to dissolve jello

instructions:
2 small boxes grape Jello
2 cups hot water to dissolve Jello. Add entire contents of 1 large can crushed pineapple, 1 can blueberry pie filling.
When gelatin mixture sets, top with 8 oz cream cheese, 1 pt. sour cream, approximately... (remainder of note is illegible - faint pencil bleed-through on the back of the card)

name: Sunburst Macaroni Salad
author: Kraft - Anne Brock
instructions:
Prepare Velveeta Shells & Cheese as directed on package.
Add remaining ingredients; mix lightly.
Chill. Add additional mayonnaise before serving, if desired. 6 to 8 servings.

Prep time: 15 minutes plus chilling.

Variation: Substitute Miracle Whip Salad Dressing for mayonnaise.

name: Cinnamon Rolls
author: Anne Brock
instructions:
Mix: 1/3 c warm water and 1 1/2 pkg. yeast.
1 c. warm milk, 1/4 c. melted shortening, 1/2 c sugar, 1 beaten egg.
Add enough flour to have stickiness (3 1/2 c.)
Add salt to stop growth.
Let rise covered.
Roll out 1/2" thick, spread with melted butter and 1/3 c sugar to 2 tsp. cinn. Roll and cut, let rise again.
Bake 425 until browned. Frost with powdered sugar icing.

name: Banana Cake or Bread
author: Anne Brock
instructions:
Bake at 350°, 30 min.

Icing: brown sugar, butter, milk, vanilla, powdered sugar (no mixing/cooking method given on card).

Note: 1 1/2 recipe makes 2 nice loaves.

name: Banana Bread
author: Anne Brock
instructions:
Sift together the dry ingredients. Cream butter and sugar, add egg, stir in banana, orange and rind. Add all ingredients only until mixture is moist. Turn into greased loaf pan.
Bake 350 for 1 hr.

name: Stroganoff
author: Anne Brock
instructions:
Cook 10 min. Add sour cream and mushrooms.
Serve over shell macaroni.

name: Egg Plant Casserole
author: Anne Brock
instructions:
Egg plant steamed
Sprinkle with 1 Tbsp flour, salt, pepper and sugar
1 c cooked noodles
Dot with butter
Pour on 1 c. tomato juice
Top with bread crumbs and cheese stripes

Can add meat. Browned ground beef

name: Squash Casserole
author: Anne Brock
instructions:
Saute onion and pepper in 1/2 stick oleo.
Combine all ingredients, mix well.
Bake 350 for 20 min.
Top with stripes of cheese and melt.

name: Cheese-Sausage Biscuits
author: Anne Brock

ingredients.name: lb. coon cheese or any aged cheese

instructions:
Melt a lb. of coon cheese or any aged cheese, add a lb of raw hot sausage. Blend well.
Add this mixture to 3 cups Bisquick. Stir well.
Shape in small balls, cook 350 for 15-20 min
Serve hot. Makes 60 balls

name: Cole Slaw
author: Anne Brock
instructions:
Layer in a bowl, over each layer sprinkle sugar until you have used 1/2 cup.

Boil: 1 c white vinegar, 2 Tbsp sugar, 1/2 tsp garlic salt, 1 tsp celery seed, 3/4 c. oil, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp dry mustard.

Pour over vegetables, wait 1 hr. mix lightly. Set aside for 2-3 hrs. Mix again and serve.
Stays fresh for 3-4 days.

name: Sausage Rolls
author: Anne Brock

ingredients.name: lb. mild Italian sausage in casing (cut in 4 equal parts)

instructions:
Roll biscuits in butter and cheese, bake edgewise to form a loaf.
Fry sausage 4-5 min, slice rolls in half, spread with butter and 1 piece of sausage.
Saute onion and pepper, add pizza sauce, spoon on rolls.

name: Cranberry Salad
author: Anne Brock
instructions: Drain pineapple but retain syrup. In saucepan combine jello, sugar & enough water added to pineapple juice to make 2 cups. Heat & stir until all ingredients are dissolved. Add lemon juice to jello mixture. Chill until almost set - then stir in fruit & nuts. Mix well & return to refrigerator until firm - overnight if possible.

name: Pepper Steak
author: Anne Brock
instructions:
Brown meat cubes in shortening, sprinkle onion soup mix on top, add 2 c water.
Simmer 30 min. Add green pepper and cook 10 min more. Thicken. Serve over rice.

name: School Rolls
author: Anne Brock
instructions:
Let rise in bowl - punch down and make biscuits - let rise.
425°

name: Pork Chops Stuffed
author: Anne Brock
instructions: Lightly brown chops in drippings filled with the stuffing. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Place on rack in roasting pan, bake 350 for 30 min. Uncover and continue to cook for 30 more min.

name: Texas Hash
author: Anne Brock
instructions:
1 lb. ground beef browned. Add: 3 1/2 c tomato juice, 1 c chopped g. pepper, 1/2 c onion, 1/2 c raw rice, 1/2 tsp. salt, 1/2 tsp basil, pepper.

Cover and simmer for 25 min. Cover top with cheese and melt before serving.

name: Beans & Wieners Basket
author: Anne Brock
instructions: Place Pork & Beans in 1-qt. casserole; add next 5 ingredients; mix well. Bake uncovered 15 minutes at 375°. Cut wieners in half and stand around edge of casserole. Return to oven; bake 15 minutes longer. Makes 4 servings.

name: Tamale Pie
author: Anne Brock
instructions:
1 lb ground beef browned with 1/2-1 Tbsp chili powder and 1 chopped onion.
Add 1 can whole kernel corn, 1 can tomatoes, and salt. Simmer 45 min.

Cover with 1/2 c sifted flour, 2 Tbsp sugar, 1/2 tsp salt, 2 tsp b. powder, 1/2 c yellow corn meal, 1 egg, 1/2 c milk, 2 Tbsp lard.

Pour batter over meat mixture. Bake 425 for 20-25 min. Invert to serve.

name: Ham and Cheese Roll-ups
author: General Mills - Anne Brock

ingredients.name: oz. thinly sliced cooked smoked ham
c. shredded Swiss or Cheddar cheese
oz. can mushroom stems and pieces, drained

instructions:
Mix baking mix and water until dough forms. Smooth into ball on cloth-covered surface dusted with baking mix. Knead 15 times. Roll into rectangle, 15x9 inches; spread with mustard. Top with remaining ingredients. Roll up tightly, beginning at 15-inch side. Pinch edge into roll (moisten if necessary). Wrap and refrigerate at least 30 minutes but no longer than 24 hours. Heat oven to 400°. Cut into 12 slices. Place on greased and floured cookie sheet (replace filling if necessary). Bake until golden, 20 to 25 minutes. 6 servings.

High Altitude: Heat oven to 425°.

name: Green Pepper Steak
author: Anne Brock

ingredients.name: lb. beef chuck or round, fat trimmed
tsp. grated fresh ginger, or 1/2 tsp. ground ginger
cup red or green peppers, cut into 1-inch squares

instructions:
A good family dish, you cut economy beef, either chuck or round into thin strips and cook it until tender; then add vegetables.

1. With a very sharp knife cut beef across grain into thin strips, 1/8-inch thick.
2. Combine soy sauce, garlic, ginger. Add beef. Toss and set aside while preparing vegetables.
3. Heat oil in large frying pan or wok. Add beef and toss over high heat until browned. Taste meat. If it is not tender, cover and simmer for 30 to 40 min. over low heat.
4. Turn heat up and add vegetables. Toss until vegetables are tender crisp, about 10 min.
5. Mix cornstarch with water. Add to pan; stir and cook until thickened.
6. Add tomatoes and heat through.

name: Ground Beef John Bon Getty
author: Anne Brock
instructions:
1 1/2 lb ground beef browned with 2 chopped onions.
Cook spaghetti and drain, add 1 chopped green pepper, 1 can tomato soup, 1 can mushroom soup, 1 can green peas and spaghetti to meat.
Pour into greased casserole dish and top with cheese. Cook in slow oven 20 min. or in electric skillet.

name: Sugar Cookies
author: Mrs. Coats - Anne Brock
instructions:
Cream sugar and butter, add eggs. Stir in flour until dough looks thick enough to roll.
Chill and roll small amount at a time.
Cut with cookie cutters. Sprinkle with sugar before baking.

name: Grilled Potato Packets
author: Happy Times - Anne Brock

ingredients.name: or 5 medium potatoes, peeled and thinly sliced

instructions:
(Note: the original title for this recipe wasn't captured in the photo - it's clipped from a "Happy Times" newsletter column and likely had a title on a preceding page.)

These can be baked in the oven or grilled outdoors. However you choose to cook them they are a wonderful compliment to any meal.

Using heavy aluminum foil pull off four one-foot sheets. Fold in half and seal edges of two sides. Divide potatoes and onions among these four pockets. Dot with butter. Mix cheese, parsley, Worcestershire sauce together and divide and sprinkle into the four pockets. Add salt to taste. Now add 1 to 2 tablespoons of chicken broth to each pocket. Seal opening tightly. Place in 375° oven for 30 to 45 minutes or until potatoes are tender. If grilling, grill covered over medium coals for 35-40 minutes or until tender.

name: Egg - Sausage Casserole
author: Anne Brock
instructions:
Drain sausage, layer bread, sausage, and cheese. Beat eggs, milk and seasonings and pour over.

Bake 350° covered 1 Hr. in lightly greased casserole.

* Great to prepare the previous night for a quick and easy breakfast.

name: Coconut Macaroons
author: Anne Brock
instructions:
Blend well, drop by teaspoon onto well greased baking sheet about one inch apart.
Bake at 350 until delicate brown or about 8 min. Remove at once. A cherry may be placed in center of macaroon before baking.

name: Sugar Cookies
author: Anne Brock
instructions:
Cream butter, sugar. Add eggs. Beat 2 minutes. Sift flour and soda, salt and baking powder. Add to creamed mixture alternating with milk. Chill. Greased cookie sheet. 375° - 12 minutes - 4 dozen.
Decorate or adapt as desired.

Frosting: 2 c. powdered sugar and 3 T. butter (melted) together. Add milk to desired thickness.

name: Lemon Cheese Bars
author: Anne Brock

ingredients.name: Duncan Hines Pudding Recipe Yellow Cake Mix

instructions: Mix dry cake mix, 1 egg and 1/3 cup oil until crumbly; reserve 1 cup. Pat remaining mixture lightly in an ungreased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake 15 minutes at 350°. Beat cheese, sugar, lemon juice and 1 egg until light and smooth. Spread over baked layer. Sprinkle with reserved crumb mixture. Bake 15 minutes longer. Cool. Cut into bars.

name: Hello Dolly Cookies
author: Anne Brock
instructions: Mix crumbs and butter, press into 7 x 11 pan. Spread remaining ingredients and pour condensed milk over all. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes. Cool over night. Cut into squares and serve.

name: Coconut-Pineapple Squares
author: Anne Brock
instructions:
Mix and press into 8 or 9-inch square pan. Bake at 350°F. for 15 minutes. Cool slightly. Spread evenly with one cup well-drained crushed pineapple.

Topping:
Mix topping ingredients together and spread over top of pineapple. Bake another 20-30 minutes at 350°F. or until browned.

name: Creamy Lemon Cheese Cake
author: Anne Brock

ingredients.name: pkg. Duncan Hines Pudding Recipe Lemon Cake Mix
pkgs. (8 oz. each) cream cheese, softened

instructions: Measure 1 cup dry cake mix; set aside. Combine remaining mix with 1 egg and 1/3 cup oil. Press in the bottom of a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan. Bake at 350° F. for 10 minutes. Meanwhile, combine reserved mix, 2 eggs and remaining ingredients; beat at low speed for 2 minutes. Spread over crust. Bake at 350° F. about 35 minutes longer. Cool.

name: Peanut Butter Tea Cookies
author: Anne Brock

ingredients.name: roll Pillsbury peanut butter cookie dough

instructions:
Cut into 12 slices, cut each into 4 pieces.
Place 1 in each teabiscuit cupcake pan
Bake 350 for 8-10 min. Remove from oven and immediately press into center of each a bite size miniature peanut butter cup
Takes 2 boxes of peanut butter cups, makes 48.

name: Peanut Butter Cups
author: Anne Brock
instructions:
Mix well until smooth, press into buttered 9x9" pan.

Melt over hot water:
2 c. chocolate chips
Spread over cracker mixture, refrigerate until firm, cut into squares.

name: Peanut Butter Bon-Bons
author: Anne Brock

ingredients.name: lb. (8 oz.) chocolate squares, for dipping
oz. pkg. chocolate chips, for dipping

instructions:
Mix, add 4-5 cups Rice Krispies.
Mix well, shape into balls.
Dip in choc. Lay on wax paper.
Cool.

Choc Mixture (for dipping): Melt chocolate squares, chocolate chips, and paraffin together.

name: Katydids
author: Anne Brock

ingredients.name: graham cracker crumbs (crushed, to line pan)

instructions:
Into oblong pan spread with crushed graham cracker crumbs.
Pour 1 can Eagle Brand milk
Sprinkle with coconut, pecans and chocolate chips.

Bake 25 min in a 375 oven or until coconut is browned.

name: Fudge
author: Anne Brock
instructions:
Cook to 236 degrees on candy thermometer.
Add: 2 6 oz. pkg. choc chips, 1 pt. marshmallow cream, nuts
Mix together and pour into buttered pan.

name: Mamie's Million Dollar Fudge
author: Anne Brock

ingredients.name: packages (4 oz. each) sweet cooking chocolate

instructions:
Combine semisweet chocolate pieces, sweet cooking chocolate, marshmallow cream and walnuts in large bowl.
Combine sugar, salt, butter or margarine and evaporated milk in large heavy saucepan. Heat to boiling, stirring constantly. Boil 5 minutes.
Pour at once over chocolate mixture in bowl, stir vigorously with a wooden spoon until chocolate is melted and mixture is creamy.
Pour into buttered shallow pan, 13x9x2.
Let stand few hours to set and cool.
Cut into squares.

name: Peanut Butter Fudge
author: Anne Brock
instructions:
Combine sugar & milk - cook to soft ball stage, remove from heat & stir in marshmallow cream, peanut butter & vanilla.

Pour into buttered pan.

name: Angel Crisp (Sugar) Cookies
author: Anne Brock
instructions:
Cream: 1/2 c sugar, 1/2 c brown sugar, 1/2 c shortening, 1/2 c butter.
Add: 1 egg, 1 t vanilla, 2 c flour, 1/2 t baking soda, 1 t cream of tartar.

Form into ball size of walnut. Roll in sugar. Flatten with fork.
Brown 350°.

name: Apple Dumplings
author: Anne Brock

ingredients.name: baking apples, 3" in diameter, pared and cored

instructions:
Prepare pastry, cut into 7x7" squares.
Baking apples 3" in diameter, pared and cored.

Into each apple place equal parts of:
3 Tabsp. raisins
3 Tblsp. chopped nuts
Moisten corners of pastry squares and fold over apple. Place in ungreased baking pan.
Heat 2 c. brown sugar and 1 c. water.
Pour around dumplings, spooning over during baking. Bake 425 degrees, 40 minutes or until golden brown. May be topped with whipped cream.

name: Apricot Nut Bread
author: Robin Hood Pre-sifted Flour - Anne Brock

ingredients.name: cups + 2 tbsp. Robin Hood All-Purpose Flour

instructions:
Soak apricots in hot water for 30 minutes before preparing batter.
Spoon flour (not sifted) into dry measuring cup. Level off and pour measured flour into mixing bowl.
Add sugar, baking powder, salt and soda to flour (not sifted) and stir well to blend.
Combine well-beaten eggs, orange juice and melted butter. Add liquid ingredients to blended dry ingredients. Stir until blended.
Fold in apricots and nuts.
Spread in greased 9x5x3-inch loaf pan.
Bake at 325° for 60-65 minutes. Remove from pan immediately.
Cool on rack.

name: Biscuits
author: Mrs. Coats - Anne Brock
instructions: (No instructions were written on this card - only the ingredient list was captured. The preparation/baking steps may be missing.)

name: Aloha Loaf
author: Anne Brock
instructions:
Cream oleo and sugar, add eggs, mix well, stir in bananas. Sift and add dry ingredients, fold in pineapple and coconut. Pour into 2 greased and floured loaf pans.
Bake 350° for 1 hr. 10 min. Remove to cool.

name: Corn Sticks
author: Anne Brock
instructions: Beat all ingredients together and bake in greased tins the shape of ears of corn in a 500 degree oven for 12 minutes.

name: Banana Blueberry Bread
author: Anne Brock
instructions:
Sprinkle blueberries with 2 teaspoons of the flour and put aside. Sift together remaining flour, sugar, baking powder, soda and salt. Stir in the oats. Blend together eggs, shortening and bananas. Add to dry ingredients, stirring until just combined.

Add blueberries stirring just enough to distribute evenly throughout batter. Pour batter into greased and lightly floured loaf pan. Combine topping mixture and sprinkle over loaf. Bake in 350 degree oven for 60 minutes, or until tested done. Let cool 10 minutes, remove from pan and cool completely. Wrap cooled bread and store one day before slicing.

name: Corn Rolls
author: Anne Brock
instructions: Sift dry ingredients, cut in butter, beat egg and milk, mix slowly. Turn onto floured board, shape into ball. Roll 1/2" thick, cut in 2" rounds. Dot with pea size butter, fold in half. Press edges. Place on greased cookie sheet, brush with butter. Bake 450 for 10-12 min.

name: Granny Rolls
author: Anne Brock

ingredients.name: pkg. yeast, dissolved in 2 c. warm water

instructions:
Mix with electric mixer until smooth. Spoon into muffin tins. Ungreased.

(Note: no baking temperature or time is given on the card.)

name: Cranberry Ring
author: Anne Brock

ingredients.name: (10 1/2 to 11 oz.) can frozen cranberry relish

instructions:
First layer: Dissolve strawberry gelatin in hot water. Add cranberry relish, dash salt. Pour into 6 1/2 cup ring mold. Chill until firm.

Second layer: Drain pineapple, reserving juice. Dissolve lemon gelatin in boiling water, add marshmallows and stir till melted; add reserved pineapple juice (or syrup). Chill till partially set. Blend cream cheese, mayonnaise. Stir in pineapple. If mixture is thin, chill till it mounds slightly when spooned. Fold in whipped cream. Pour over first layer. Chill until firm. Unmold. Surround with parsley. Serves 10-12.

name: Taco Dip
author: Anne Brock
instructions:
1 can taco dip spread on pizza pan.

16 oz. sour cream mixed with 1 pkg. taco seasoning.

Layer: lettuce, onion, tomatoes, olives + cheese

name: Menta
author: Anne Brock
instructions: (No preparation steps were written on this card - only the ingredient list and yield.)

name: Turtlettes
author: Anne Brock
instructions:
Arrange pecans into turtles, four legs and a head, on a well buttered plate.
Arrange 6 caramels around the pecans. Microwave on high 15 to 30 sec.
Press down with waxed paper.
Coat with choc chip coating.

Chocolate Chip Coating: Put chocolate chips and vegetable oil in bowl. Cover with waxed paper and microwave 2 1/2 to 4 min. Careful not to burn.

name: Salt Dough
author: Anne Brock
instructions: Cook 2-3 min. When cool enough to handle, knead several min. Add food coloring before kneading

name: Play Dough
author: Anne Brock
instructions:
Mix powders, add oil and water. Stir into ball and add food coloring before cooking.

Cook until ball forms (few minutes)

name: Taco Dip
author: Anne Brock
instructions:
Spread 8 oz. cream cheese on pizza pan. Top with 1 jar taco sauce.
olives
Monz. cheese

(Note: card says "(over)" indicating more content on the back, which was not captured in this photo set - quantities for olives/cheese and any further steps may be missing.)

name: Dough For Bread Baskets
author: Anne Brock
instructions:
1 c salt dissolved in 1 c warm water.
Add 2 1/2 c flour

name: Ornaments
author: Anne Brock
instructions:
Mix, roll, cut. Bake 350 1 Hr.
Don't forget hole for hanger

name: Party Mix
author: Anne Brock
instructions:
Melt 1 stick butter, 2 tsp garlic salt, and 4 tsp. Worcestershire sauce. Spoon over mixture and cook stirring often until done.
250 for 45 min, stirring every 15 min.

name: Festive Cheese Ball with Grapes
author: Anne Brock

ingredients.name: lbs. blue/black, green and red table grapes, cut into small clusters

instructions: Combine cream cheese, Cheddar cheese and hot pepper sauce in small mixer bowl; blend well. Place cheese mixture into 1-quart round bowl lined with plastic wrap. Cover and refrigerate until firm. Unmold and place in center of serving tray. Remove plastic wrap. Smooth cheese with spatula. Sprinkle with walnuts. Surround with grape clusters. Yield: 1-1/2 cups.

name: Tortilla Roll-ups
author: Anne Brock
instructions: Spread, ref until use & cut in 1" slices

name: Mexican Dip
author: Anne Brock
instructions:
Brown 2 lb ground beef, add 1 lb. stick chili, 2 lb. Velveeta, 2 can Chili Hot Beans, 1 can Rotel, 1/2 pt. sour cream, 1 jar hot taco sauce.

Serve over bite size Fritos. Top with lettuce, tomatoes, onions and taco sauce.

name: Broccoli Dip
author: Anne Brock
instructions:
Cook broccoli with onion.
Drain well - mix.

Mix in mushroom soup, oleo, and garlic cheese.
Mix.

name: Guacamole Spread
author: Anne Brock
instructions:
Serve on lettuce leaves
or stuff tomatoes

name: Dill Dip
author: Cindy Williams - Anne Brock
instructions: Mix together and serve after chilling one hour.

name: Taco Dip
author: Kathy Casteel from Ann Dickerson - Anne Brock
instructions: Spread bean dip on plate. Mix avocado, lemon, and salt and spread over bean dip. Mix mayonnaise, sour cream and taco seasoning and spread over avocado mixture. Top with tomatoes, cheese and black olive slices. Serve with tortilla chips.

name: Broccoli - Cheese Dip
author: Anne Brock
instructions:
Cook broccoli and onion; drain. Add garlic cheese, mushroom soup, and butter.

Serve warm.

name: Onion Batter
author: Anne Brock
instructions:
Combine 1 cup flour, 1 tsp baking powder and 1/4 tsp salt.
Beat 1 egg until thick and lemon colored.
Stir in dry ingredients, beat until smooth.
Cover and set aside while preparing onions.

Deep fry

name: Russian Tea
author: Anne Brock
instructions:
Mix in bowl and store in jar.
Dissolve 2 tsp. in one cup of boiling water.

name: Vegetables Marinated
author: Anne Brock

ingredients.name: can whole beets, drained and quartered
lb. summer squash, sliced and blanched
lb carrots, cut in 3 inch strips

instructions:
Marinate beets and beans separately.

Marinate: Mix corn oil, lemon juice, salt, dry mustard, vinegar, grated onion, sugar and pepper in jar and cover tightly and shake well.
Use as marinate or salad dressing.

name: Red Punch
author: Anne Brock
instructions: Mix well, put in 1 gal milk containers, leaving enough room for 1/2 bottle gingerale. Add gingerale just before serving.

name: Punch
author: Anne Brock
instructions: Add water with juices

name: Bubbling Pineapple Punch
author: Dole - Anne Brock

ingredients.name: oz. can Dole Pineapple Juice, chilled

instructions: Combine chilled pineapple juice and apricot nectar in a large punch bowl. Add soda and sherbet just before serving.

name: Butter Pecan Ice Cream
author: Anne Brock

ingredients.name: reg. size box Fr. vanilla instant pudding mix

instructions:
Stir unsalted butter and chopped pecans until brown (3 min).

Whisk in French vanilla pudding mix and Milnot.

Blend in sugar, vanilla, and whole milk.

Freeze.

name: Mints
author: Anne Brock
instructions:
In rounded center pour 1/2 (2 sticks) butter and 1 can Eagle Brand milk.
Add flavoring and mix until mixture is not sticky or to correct consistency (may take more sugar)
Flatten and cut into shape.

name: Punch
author: Anne Brock
instructions:
Add water to fill container.

Garnish with orange slices.

name: Apple Nut Bundt Cake
author: Alice Hopper - Anne Brock
instructions:
Mix all of above & beat 2 min.

Stir in:
3 c. coarse chopped apples (1/2 inch)
1 1/2 c chopped nuts
1 c. raisins

Spoon into greased & floured bundt pan.
350° for 1 hr 10 min.
String with sugar glaze

name: Creamy Easter Eggs
author: Anne Brock
instructions:
Boil 1, 2, 3, 2 or 3 min, drain, reserve liq. Combine liq, sugar, clear syrup, salt & water. Cover, bring to boil.

Cook to 250°. Stir until lukewarm & opaque. Add marshmallow cream, vanilla. Stir until creamy, add nuts & fruit.

Knead into candy, form eggs, [illegible word] stand 2 hrs. Dip

name: Party Punch
author: Anne Brock
instructions:
Mix - chill.

(If you use pre-sweetened Kool-aid, cut down on sugar.)

name: German Chocolate Coconut Pecan Topping
author: Anne Brock
instructions: Using 8- or 9-inch round layer cake pans, make and cool cake as directed on the label. In a medium saucepan combine sugar, evaporated milk, egg yolks and shortening. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until thickened, about 12 minutes. Remove from heat; stir in vanilla, coconut and pecans. Cool until thick enough to spread, about 1 hour.

name: Cream Filling for Susie Q
author: Anne Brock
instructions:
5 T flour, 5 T sugar, 1 c milk - cook until thick.

1/2 c butter, 1/2 c shortening, 1 c sugar, 1 t vanilla, dash salt - cream, mix & beat 5 min.

name: Bok Choy Salad
author: Jean Cerva - Anne Brock

ingredients.name: large head napa (Chinese) cabbage / or bok choy

instructions:
Dressing: 1/4 cup vinegar, 1/2 cup sugar, 3/4 cup oil, seasoning packet from noodles. Boil 1 min. then cool.

Melt oleo in skillet over med. heat, add almonds, noodles, & sesame seeds. Stir until brown. Let cool and cover.

Chop cabbage and onions, cover and refrigerate.

When ready to serve mix together.

Recipe is party size (for family cut recipe in 1/2).

See also recipe #1051, Jeanne Goodman's version of this recipe.

name: Fudge
author: Great Value - Anne Brock

ingredients.name: Tbsp. Great Value Sweet Cream Butter
tsp. Great Value Pure Vanilla Extract

instructions: Line an 8 inch square baking pan with aluminum foil. Combine sugar, evaporated milk, butter and salt in a heavy medium-sized saucepan. Bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring constantly. Continue to boil, stirring constantly, for 4 to 5 minutes. Remove from heat. Stir in marshmallows, chocolate chips, nuts and vanilla extract. Stir for 1 minute or until marshmallows are melted. Pour into the prepared baking pan; refrigerate for 2 hours or until firm. Lift the fudge from the pan and remove the foil. Cut into 48 pieces to serve.

name: Butter Swim Biscuits
author: 12 Tomatoes - Anne Brock
instructions:
Preheat oven to 450°F.
In a medium bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, sugar, and salt.
Add buttermilk and mix just until a moist dough is formed.
Pour melted butter into an 8x8-inch baking dish and place dough on top of melted butter. Using a spatula, spread dough evenly across pan until it touches the sides.
Cut dough into 9 equal squares and bake until golden brown, 20-25 minutes. Enjoy!

name: Comfort Lasagna Soup
author: Woman's World - Anne Brock

ingredients.name: can (15 oz.) petite diced tomatoes with juice
cup fresh basil, chopped, plus more for garnish
uncooked lasagna noodles, broken into bite-size pieces
cup finely grated Parmesan cheese, plus more for garnish

instructions:
In large pot, heat olive oil over medium heat. Add onion; cook 3 minutes. Stir in garlic; cook 1 minute. Add sausage; cook, breaking up with wooden spoon as it browns, about 10 minutes. Pour off any excess fat from pot and gradually stir in chicken stock.

Add tomatoes with juice, tomato paste, oregano, thyme and basil. Bring to boil over medium-high heat. Add lasagna noodles; cook until noodles are tender, 10-15 minutes. Reduce heat to low; stir in mozzarella and Parmesan. Season with salt and pepper. Ladle soup into bowls; top with Parmesan, fresh basil and ricotta, if desired.

name: Loaded Baked Potato Soup
author: Woman's World - Anne Brock

ingredients.name: tsp. garlic salt, plus more to taste

instructions:
Pierce potatoes multiple times with fork, then microwave 12-15 minutes or until tender. Alternatively, preheat oven to 350°F and bake potatoes 45 minutes or until fork-tender. Carefully halve potatoes; cool. Once cool enough to handle, remove skins and cut into chunks.

Meanwhile, cook bacon in skillet over medium-high heat until crisp. Transfer to paper towel-lined plate to drain and cool. Reserve up to 1 Tbs. bacon fat from pan, discarding the rest. Once bacon has cooled, crumble into small pieces.

In large pot, melt butter over medium-low heat. Add reserved bacon fat and garlic and onion; cook 2-3 minutes or until onion is tender. Gradually whisk flour into pot; stir 1-2 minutes. Gradually whisk in milk and half-and-half, whisking until smooth. Gradually whisk in chicken stock. Bring to gentle simmer; whisk in kosher salt, garlic salt and pepper. Keep at a gentle simmer until mixture has thickened slightly, 5-7 minutes.

If garnish is desired, reserve 1/4 cup each of cheeses and bacon. Stir in remaining cheeses and bacon and sour cream. Remove pot from heat. Scoop potato chunks into pan, breaking into small pieces or leaving chunky, as desired. Serve topped with desired garnishes.

name: Chicken Tortellini Soup
author: Woman's World - Anne Brock

ingredients.name: small boneless, skinless chicken breast halves, cut into bite-size pieces
oz. cheese tortellini or egg noodles

instructions:
In medium pot, melt butter over medium heat. Add onion; cook 2 minutes. Stir in garlic; cook until onion becomes translucent. Gradually add flour, stirring, until mixture becomes a thick paste and turns light golden brown.

Gradually whisk in chicken stock; bring to gentle simmer. Add chicken, carrots, celery, lemon juice, parsley and thyme. Simmer 8-10 minutes or until vegetables are just tender.

Stir in tortellini; simmer 8-10 minutes or until tortellini and chicken are cooked. Remove from heat; season with salt and pepper.

name: One-Pot Taco Soup
author: Woman's World - Anne Brock

ingredients.name: cup diced red or yellow pepper
cans (15 oz. each) diced tomatoes with juice
can (15 oz.) black beans, drained, rinsed
can (15 oz.) dark red kidney beans, drained, rinsed
Tbs. taco seasoning, plus more to taste
Optional toppings: chopped fresh cilantro, sour cream, shredded cheese, sliced avocado and tortilla strips

instructions:
In large stockpot or Dutch oven, brown ground beef over medium heat. Drain any excess fat from pot. Stir in onion and peppers; cook 3 minutes or until onion is tender.

Add tomato sauce, salsa, diced tomatoes with juice, black beans, kidney beans, corn, green chiles, cilantro, taco seasoning, 1/4 cup water and salt and pepper to taste. Stir until combined. Cover pot; simmer, stirring occasionally, 20-30 minutes. (This only gets better with time, so if you can, let it simmer longer.) Add up to 1/4 cup more water if soup starts getting too thick. Taste and add more taco seasoning, salt or pepper as needed. Ladle soup into bowls and add favorite toppings.

name: Cake Mix Oatmeal Cookies
author: Roberta - Anne Brock
instructions:
Mix and let set 5 min. for oats to soak.
Drop by teaspoon balls onto slightly greased cookie sheet.
Bake 350° for 9 min.
Makes 5 dozen.

See also recipe #1050, a version of this recipe from Roberta Wheeler.

name: Sausage Biscuits
author: Anne Brock
instructions:
400° - 8-10 min.
Muffin pan.
Mix 2 c. cheddar cheese with raw sausage.
Separate each biscuit & place in pan.
Top with parmesan cheese.

name: Cake Mix Oatmeal Cookies
author: Roberta Wheeler - Anne Brock
instructions:
Mix all and let set a few minutes so oatmeal absorbs oil.
Drop by teaspoon onto cookie sheet. Bake 350°.

See also recipe #1048, another version of this recipe.

name: Bok Choy Salad
author: Jeanne Goodman - Anne Brock
instructions:
Boil 1 minute, then cool.

Melt oleo in skillet over medium heat, add almonds, noodles and sesame seeds. Stir until brown. Let cool and cover.

Chop cabbage and onions, cover and refrigerate (can be done the day before)

When ready to serve, mix and serve.

This recipe is party size, but dressing and stir fry can be kept for several days for further use.

See also recipe #1041, Jean Cerva's version of this recipe.

name: Bread Pudding
author: Anne Brock
instructions:
Bake 350° for 45-55 min.
Soak 5-10 min, mix.

Put 1/2 into 8x8 pan, top with 1/2 of butter/sugar/pecan mixture. Top with remainder.

name: America's Classic No-Fail Chocolate Chip Cookies
author: Blue Bonnet - Anne Brock

ingredients.name: cup Blue Bonnet stick, melted, cooled (1 cup = 2 sticks)

instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 375°F. Combine flour, baking soda and salt in medium bowl; set aside.
2. Beat Blue Bonnet, granulated sugar and brown sugar by hand in large bowl until combined. Add eggs and vanilla; beat until well blended. Add flour mixture; mix until just combined. Stir in chocolate morsels.
3. Drop cookie dough by rounded tablespoons onto ungreased cookie sheet about 1-1/2 inches apart.
4. Bake 12 to 14 minutes or until edges are crisp but centers are still soft. Let stand 2 minutes on cookie sheet before removing and cooling completely on wire racks.

name: Spinach Salad
author: Anne Brock

ingredients.name: hard boiled eggs, coarse chopped or sliced
small onion or shallot, finely chopped

instructions:
For the salad dressing, combine those ingredients together in a small saucepan or skillet. Heat through until warm and sugar is dissolved. Don't boil or overheat too much.

For the salad, combine those ingredients together in a large bowl in the amounts you desire, by adding or taking away ingredients as you choose.

When ready to serve, gently pour desired amount of warmed dressing over salad and serve immediately.

name: Wilted Spinach
author: Anne Brock
instructions: In saucepan, cook garlic in oil until crisp, 5 min. Drain (reserve garlic chips and oil). Add spinach and cook 4 min. Salt and pepper. Mix with garlic chips.

name: Chicken and Rice Casserole
author: Anne Brock
instructions:
Rice, broth, and cream of mushroom soup with chicken, cubed.

Brado, complete.

Add onion soup mix. Bake at 360°, 60-70 min.

name: Potato Soup
author: Anne Brock
instructions:
Butter in pan. Bacon, raw (cook). Transfer to pot. Add broth, cook. Add half-and-half.

Add mashed potatoes and milk. Stir in Velveeta until melted.

name: Hash Brown Ham & Egg Casserole
author: Anne Brock
instructions: Hash brown potatoes, Monterey jack cheese, green onions, and canned ham. Add 8 eggs, beaten, and 2 c. milk. Bake at 350°, 45 min.

name: Mexican Cornbread
author: Anne Brock
instructions:
Yields 18 muffins
Preheat oven to 250 degrees.
Beat eggs well. Add remaining ingredients.
Bake in muffin pan or pan of your choice. Bake at 350 for 20 minutes or until brown.

name: Bundt Cake
author: Anne Brock
instructions:
Mix all - in floured bundt pan
350 50 min
Cool 10 min

name: Broccoli/Cheese Soup
author: Anne Brock
instructions:
Saute onion in butter.
Add salt & pepper.
Stir in flour.
Stir in milk & chicken broth; cook until thick.
Add cooked broccoli.
Add cheddar cheese.

name: Cho. Pecan Clusters
author: Kenneth R. Haas - Anne Brock

ingredients.name: lb pecans (alternate batch size mentioned for butter/salt below)

instructions:
Using two (2) cho. to one (1) white bark squares melt the best way you like. I started using a double boiler and continue to do so. I usually use six (6) cho. to three (3) white with one (1) and a forth pounds of pecans. You can use less or more what ever you like. For two (2) pounds of nuts I use a stick and a half of salted butter with a teaspoon of sea salt. I use sea salt because I think it melts better. Melt this in the microwave and stir this good until salt is all melted. Pour over pecans and stir good before putting in oven. I roast the nuts on 300° for at least an hour or so until they taste roasted. During the roasting time I will get them out at least three (3) times to stir them good. When you think the pecans are roasted enough stir them in your melted bark until covered real good. Spoon out on wax paper the size you want them to be. I usually get seventy-five to eighty pieces depends on the size you want. I get the bark (24 oz. pkg) at Wal-Mart and the butter at Aldi's.

I hope you enjoy making this candy as I have for so long. I want to note that my son Tom was the one that told me to try roasting the nuts and I have to say that is what makes this candy so good, not me.

If you have any questions, feel free to give me a call. I hope my recipe for making cho pecan clusters has been plain enough. For me a lot of love goes in making this candy and I will close by saying may God bless you always.

name: Apple Cider Pork Loin
author: Anne Brock
instructions:
Season with salt, pepper & onions.
Place oil in inner pot. Press "Chicken/meat" button, sear the loin on all sides. remove.
Saute onions. Add all ingredients.
lock lid - press cancel.
Press "Chick-meat" button - time 20 min.
"Keep Warm" will appear when time is up. Press cancel, switch valve to open.
remove.

name: Pot Pie
author: Anne Brock

ingredients.name: stick butter, melted in casserole pan
pkg. peas & carrots or mixed veg
c cream of chicken with herbs (soup)

instructions:
Pot Pie (1/2 this recipe)
1 stick butter melted in casserole pan
Chicken (rotisserie)
1 pkg. peas & carrots or mixed veg
2 c. milk mix with 1/2 pkg Bisquick herb mix
Pour over ingredients, mix
2 cups broth mix with 1 c cream of chicken with herbs
350 - 50 min

name: Cheese/Broccoli Soup (with Bacon)
author: Anne Brock

ingredients.name: cup half & half, blended with 1/4 c flour

instructions:
Blend 1 cup half & half + 1/4 c flour.
32 oz broth.
Carrots, broccoli, almonds.
Salt & pepper (last).
2 c cheese Velveeta.
Cook 10 min (simmer), chicken.

name: Garlic Soy Pan-Fried Chicken
author: Anne Brock
instructions:
Season and cut chicken.
Dredge in flour.
Fry in 2t butter; brown on both sides.

Sauce: 1t butter, 3t garlic, 2t soy, 1t honey, 1t vinegar.

Sprinkle with parsley.

name: Sweet and Sour Chicken
author: Anne Brock

ingredients.name: tsp corn starch, dissolved in water (to thicken)

instructions:
Cut chicken breasts in cubes.
Mix: 2t soy sauce, 2 Tbsp vinegar, 1 egg, + corn starch.
Season.
Brown, then add 1/2 c. water, 3t soy sauce.

Add 1t corn starch.
Transfer & brown.
2 Tbsp vinegar, 2 Tbsp dijon mustard, 2t brown sugar.
Sauté onion + pepper.
Corn starch, 3t in water, to thicken.

name: Tex-Mex Mix
author: Mature Living, January 2014 - Anne Brock
instructions: Peel, pit, and mash avocados. Mix lemon juice, salt, and pepper, and add to avocados. In another bowl, mix sour cream, mayonnaise, and taco seasoning. On a serving dish with a rim, spread bean dip. Top with avocado mixture. Layer with sour cream mixture, onion, olives, and tomatoes. Sprinkle cheese evenly on top. Serve chilled with tortilla chips.

name: Chicken Enchilada Dip
author: Mature Living, January 2014 - Anne Brock

ingredients.name: 8-ounce package reduced fat cream cheese, softened
diced jalapeño pepper or a few drops hot sauce (optional)

instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. Mix all ingredients together and place in 11-by-7-inch baking dish or 9-inch pie plate. Bake, uncovered, for 30 minutes or until edges are golden brown. Serve with crackers or pita chips.

name: Hot Parmesan-Artichoke Dip
author: Mature Living, January 2014 - Anne Brock

ingredients.name: 14-ounce can artichoke hearts, drained and chopped

instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. In a bowl, mix first five ingredients. Spoon into 9-inch pie plate. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until hot and bubbly. Sprinkle with tomatoes. Serve with your favorite cracker or pita chips.

name: Dill Dip
author: Mature Living, January 2014 - Anne Brock
instructions: Mix all ingredients and refrigerate overnight or at least eight hours. Serve chilled with assorted raw vegetables.

name: Pizza Dip
author: Anne Brock

ingredients.name: potato chips, tortilla chips, etc., for serving

instructions:
Layer everything on cookie sheet or oblong cake pan.

Cream cheese on bottom.
Marinara sauce.
Shredded cheese.
Meats.
Whatever toppings.

Bake 10-15-20 minutes ???
Melt cr. cheese & warm — good.

Serve with potato chips, tortilla chips, etc.

Really good.

name: Fruit Platter with Cream Cheese-Marshmallow Dip
author: H.A. - Anne Brock

ingredients.name: assorted fruit, cut in bite-size pieces (cantaloupe, honeydew melon, bananas, apples, strawberries, kiwi, oranges, etc.)
package Philadelphia cream cheese, room temperature
lemon juice, if desired for lemon flavor

instructions:
Get you all kinds of fruits and cantaloupe, honey dew melon, and cut up in bite size pieces: bananas, apples, strawberry, kiwi, cantaloupe, oranges, etc. All of them are good with this. Use toothpicks to eat them or fork them.

Make a fruit dip out of Philadelphia cream cheese - room temp - and large jar of marshmallow cream. Mix together till smooth - takes a few minutes. Add marshmallow cream to suit sweet taste - use most if not all.
Add lemon juice if like lemon flavor. Chill and eat.

It's great and refreshing and healthy, except the dip.

name: Pizza Dip
author: H.A. - Anne Brock
instructions:
Use cake pan or cookie sheet, according to how much you make.

Layer and pat bottom of pan with cream cheese.

Add: all kinds of pizza stuff - what you like: pizza marinara sauce, mushrooms, olives, anchovies, peppers, cheese, bacon, pepperoni, hamburger, lettuce, chicken, etc., etc.

Bake and eat. Don't know how long, etc.
Dip out of pan with chips, Doritos, etc.

Doesn't last long, it's great.
